description:
Levon & Associates LLC is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to assist with government contract research, subcontractor research, contract administration, and project management support.

s

• Able to extract specific information accurately

• Comfortable learning new software

• Able to follow written and video SOPs

• Professional communication skills

Experience with government contracting, procurement, vendor/subcontractor research, project management, CRM systems, SmartSuite, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Office is a plus but not required.

title: Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant
description:
Celestial Globe North London (CGNL) is looking for a Lettings and Property Management Assistant to support our team while working from home. You will help manage enquiries, advertise properties, support tenants through move in and day to day tenancy matters, and keep landlords updated. The role requires clear communication, careful follow up and good knowledge of UK lettings and property management.

Working arrangement  Remote, working UK hours (9:00 am to 6:00 pm).

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and publish accurate property listings on Zoopla and Rightmove, including descriptions, photographs, floor plans and key property details; check listings regularly and update availability, prices and status when instructed.

• Respond promptly to prospective tenant enquiries, arrange viewings with the relevant colleagues, follow up with applicants and help progress offers and tenancy paperwork.

• Coordinate the move in process, including referencing updates, tenancy documents, deposit administration, inventory and check in bookings, keys and clear instructions for new tenants.

• Help tenants after move in with practical questions, including how to register council tax, gas, electricity, water and broadband accounts; liaise with suppliers or the council where needed and follow up until issues are resolved.

• Log maintenance requests, gather the information and photographs needed, obtain quotes or arrange contractors as appropriate, schedule access, track progress and confirm completion with tenants and landlords.

• Keep landlords and tenants informed about repairs, delays, costs and next steps; flag urgent issues promptly to the property manager.

• Arrange check outs, inventories and end of tenancy cleaning; help gather evidence for proposed deposit deductions and communicate the outcome clearly.

• Track tenancy dates and assist with renewals, notices and other routine tenancy administration.

• Help arrange gas safety checks, EPCs, electrical and other required property documents or licensing where applicable, and keep records and reminders up to date.

• Assist with rent and client account administration, including checking payment records, following up on arrears, preparing information for landlord statements and escalating discrepancies.

• Maintain accurate property, landlord, tenant and contractor records; communicate with councils, utility providers, managing agents and freeholders when required; attend regular team meetings and report on open tasks.

What we are looking for

• Previous UK lettings or property management experience is essential, with a practical understanding of tenancy administration and tenant support.

• Confident written and spoken English, with a friendly and professional approach to tenants, landlords, applicants and contractors. Mandarin is an advantage.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several cases, keep clear records and follow tasks through to completion.

• Comfortable using
, spreadsheets, property databases and online listing platforms; experience with Zoopla and Rightmove is useful.

• Able to work independently from home during UK working hours, communicate proactively with the team and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to 
 with the subject line “Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant – Your Name”. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

CGNL is an equal opportunity employer. Please tell us if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

title: SEO Content & Website Assistant
description:
We are hiring a part-time, long-term remote assistant to publish and optimise content on our website and keep our local search presence in shape.



Role snapshot



Title: SEO Content & Website Assistant

Engagement: Independent contractor, remote

Hours: 15 to 20 hours per week to start, with scope to grow

Overlap: At least 3 hours per weekday within 9am to 5pm Sydney time

Payment: Monthly

Reports to: Director

About us



Squire is a Sydney building design and project management practice. We take residential and small commercial projects from design and council approvals (DA, CDC and CC) through to construction.



Our clients are homeowners, developers and builders across Sydney. They find us through Google, referrals and our past projects, so our website and Google Business Profile need to be accurate, active and easy to find.



The role



You turn our notes, photos and drafts into published, optimised web content, and you run the recurring tasks that keep us visible in local search. We give you the direction and the technical input; you make it happen reliably, every week.



Content and website



Format, optimise and publish 2 to 4 pieces per month (articles, suburb service pages, project case studies) in WordPress or our site builder

Turn voice memos, rough notes and AI drafts into clean, readable pages for our review

Write meta titles and descriptions, headings, image alt text and internal links

Resize, rename and compress project photos before upload

Keep service, team and contact pages current



Local SEO



Post weekly to our Google Business Profile, add photos and answer Q&A

Draft review replies using our templates, and send review requests to recent clients

Build and maintain directory listings (Houzz, HiPages, Yellow Pages, True Local and similar) with a consistent business name, address and phone

Find and pursue relevant local link opportunities from suppliers, builders and consultants we already work with



Maintenance and reporting



Monthly checks for broken links, missing meta data, slow pages and indexing issues in Google Search Console

A one-page monthly report covering our agreed KPIs

Turn our screen recordings into written step-by-step procedures (SOPs)

Reshare published content to LinkedIn and Instagram



What this role is not



We set the strategy and review everything before it goes live. Please do not apply expecting to run your own SEO playbook.



No paid link packages, private blog networks (PBNs) or link exchanges, ever

No publishing technical planning or building advice without our sign-off

No changes to hosting, domain or site admin settings

No contact with our clients other than approved review requests



Requirements



Must have



Excellent written English, with attention to grammar and tone

2+ years publishing content in WordPress or a similar CMS

Working knowledge of on-page SEO: meta data, headings, alt text, internal linking

Hands-on experience with Google Business Profile and directory listings

Reliable internet, a backup power or connection plan, and your own computer

Organised and consistent: you follow checklists, meet weekly deadlines and flag blockers early



Nice to have



Experience with Australian clients, ideally in building design, construction, trades or property

Google Search Console and GA4 reporting

Basic image editing (Canva, Photoshop or similar)

Comfortable using AI writing tools as a starting point, not a finished product



How we work



Tasks: a shared task board with recurring weekly and monthly tasks already set up

Training: we screen-record each task once (Loom); you turn it into a written SOP

Check-ins: a 15-minute weekly call, plus a short end-of-day update (done, next, blockers)

Access: your own logins with editor rights, shared through a password manager

Tools: WordPress, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, GA4, Canva, Microsoft 365



How we measure success (reviewed monthly)



Pieces published on schedule

Google Business Profile calls, direction requests and website clicks

Website enquiry form submissions

Rankings for 10 agreed target search terms

New Google reviews



How to apply



Send the following. Applications without them will not be reviewed.



A short cover note (under 200 words) on why this role suits you

Links to 2 or 3 pages you have published or optimised, and what you did on each

Your hourly rate, available hours and the Sydney hours you can overlap

Start your message with the words "Squire Sydney" so we know you read the full brief

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:

This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment

title: SENIOR LOAN PROCESSOR — Business Funding / MCA (Full Cycle)
description:
Read This Entire Job Post Before Applying

We're a U.S.-based business funding company that places merchants with banks, MCA lenders, SBA partners, equipment financiers, and revenue-based lenders. We close real deals every week. We don't need someone to "learn the industry" — we need someone who already lives in it.

If you've never personally pulled bank statements apart, calculated NSFs and average daily balances, stipped a file, submitted to Kapitus, OnDeck, Credibly, Idea Financial, Fundbox, Forward Financing, Headway, Lendini, or similar — this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



What You'll Actually Do (Daily)



Pre-underwrite every incoming deal: pull MCAs from bank statements, calculate position counts, true revenue, holdback capacity, debt service, NSFs, negative days, and stacking history

Build clean submission packages (app + 3-6 months bank statements + stips) and submit to the right lenders the first time

Negotiate offers — push back on lenders, get factor rates down, extend terms, raise approval amounts, fight for better commission splits

Manage the deal pipeline in our CRM from submission ? approval ? contract ? funding

Communicate directly with merchants for stips, signatures, voided checks, landlord verifications, ownership docs

Handle declines intelligently — reposition the file, find a lender that fits, don't just give up

Run renewals, refis, and stacked positions where appropriate





Required (Non-Negotiable)



Minimum 2 years processing/underwriting MCA, term loans, LOCs, or revenue-based financing for a U.S. broker shop, ISO, or direct lender

Working relationships (or recent submission experience) with at least 8 MCA lenders by name

Can read a 3-month bank statement spread and tell me the true monthly revenue, NSFs, daily balance, and how many positions are stacked — in under 10 minutes

Fluent written and spoken English (we will test this on the call)

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a working webcam

Can work U.S. CST hours



Strongly Preferred/ Not Required



Experience with iLending, Mantis, OnyxIQ, ZohoCRM, or similar broker/ISO platforms

Prior experience at a U.S. ISO or funder shop (please name them in your application)

Underwriting credentials, finance/accounting background, or formal training





Do Not Apply If



You've only done "lead gen" or "appointment setting" and want to call yourself a processor

You need someone to walk you through what a factor rate, holdback, or specified percentage is

You ghost, disappear, or go silent for days at a time

You're juggling 3 other clients and this will be your side gig

You've never actually submitted a deal to a real lender portal

You inflate your resume — we verify everything, including calling former employers





Compensation Structure

Base Salary (paid weekly or bi-weekly via Wise):



$640 - $1000 USD / month base hourly rate/ depending on experience, region, and references

30-day paid trial period at the lower end of the band — full base kicks in after passing

Reviewed every 90 days based on performance



Performance Bonuses:



3% per funded deal you fully processed (submission to funding)

+$150 bonus on any deal funded over $100K

+5% of net commission on any deal where you found the lender / negotiated terms that beat the initial offer by 10%+

Monthly volume bonus: $300 if you process 15+ funded deals in a calendar month, $750 if you process 25+



Other:



10 paid days off after 90 days

Paid U.S. holidays after 6 months

Annual performance bonus tied to total funded volume

Long-term: opportunity to grow into a Head of Underwriting / Ops role as we scale



Top performers in this role consistently clear $3,500+ in incentive/commissions only plus the base hourly rate. If that doesn't excite you, you're not the person we're looking for.



How to Apply (Follow Exactly — We Auto-Reject Applications That Don't)



1. Subject line - Pineapple Loan Processor

(Yes, "Pineapple." If you skip this word, your application is deleted unread. This is the first filter.)

2. In the body of the application, Create a voice recording and answer these in order:



How many years have you processed MCA / business loan files for U.S. shops? Which companies?



Name 8 MCA or business lenders you've personally submitted deals to in the last 12 months

What's the highest-deal-volume month you've ever personally processed? (# of funded deals + total $ funded)



A merchant has $45K monthly revenue, 6 NSFs in the last 3 months, 2 open positions totaling $850/day in payments, and a 580 FICO. Which 3 lenders do you submit to first, and why?



What's your expected monthly base salary in USD?



Confirm you can work 8 AM – 5 PM CST consistently



3. Attach:

A 60-90 second unedited video (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) introducing yourself, naming the last 3 companies you processed for, and walking us through the toughest deal you ever got funded.



(If you attach a pdf resume, it will not be looked at and you will not be considered for the position.)



4. Include three professional references with phone numbers and emails — preferably former managers at U.S. shops. We call all of them.



Applications without the code word, without the video, or with vague answers will not be reviewed. We're hiring one person. Make it obvious it should be you.

I’m a very ideas-driven person. I tend to think through messy brain dumps, interconnected ideas, half-finished thoughts, transcripts and lots of creative rabbit holes. Often I can see the big picture very clearly, but I need help turning everything in my head into organised, usable systems, projects and next steps.



A big part of this role is having someone I can think with.



What the role would look like at the beginning



Initially, I’d be looking for help with things like:



* Taking messy brain dumps, notes and AI transcripts and helping turn them into something clear and usable

* Being someone I can bounce creative ideas off

* Asking good questions and helping me develop ideas further

* Giving me genuine feedback, including telling me when you think something could be simpler or work differently

* Helping me create systems and workflows so ideas actually get implemented

* Organising projects, priorities, information and loose ends

* Keeping track of decisions, where projects are up to and what needs to happen next

* Helping break large or overwhelming projects into manageable pieces

* Taking smaller creative and organisational tasks off my plate

* Researching things when needed and bringing the useful information back in a way that is easy to process



I already have someone working with me on the IT/development side, so I’m not looking for this person to be a developer.



This role would sit more on the creative, organisation, communication and project-support side, although there may naturally be some collaboration between everyone as things grow.



Where the role could grow



I’m building something that I hope will become much bigger over time, so there is a lot of room for the right person to grow into the role.



Eventually, this could include:



* Social media planning and content development

* Helping develop creative campaigns and ideas

* Creating and organising visual resources

* Helping develop workbooks, guides and larger atlas-style books

* Turning rough concepts into polished resources

* Helping with layouts, Canva and visual storytelling

* Researching and developing new projects

* Helping keep different projects visually and creatively consistent

* Becoming much more involved in the overall creative process



Some of the things I want to create in the future are highly visual, interactive and a little outside the usual workbook format, so someone who enjoys making information interesting, human and visually engaging would probably have a lot of fun here.



What it’s like working with me



Communication is probably the most important part of this role.



I value clear, honest communication enormously.



I would much rather someone tell me:



“I’m confused about this.”



“I don’t think this is going to work.”



“I need more information.”



“I think you’ve overcomplicated this.”



“I made a mistake.”



“I’m really good at this part, but this other part isn’t my strength.”



…than quietly struggle or tell me what they think I want to hear.



I genuinely respect people who understand their own strengths and weaknesses.



Having weaknesses does not put me off hiring someone. Everyone has them. Being able to recognise them, communicate them and work around them is much more valuable to me than pretending you’re brilliant at everything.



As a boss, I’m very collaborative.



I like talking ideas through, asking for opinions and figuring things out together. I don’t want somebody who feels like they have to sit silently waiting for instructions.



At the same time, I don’t expect someone to be available 24/7 or magically know what I’m thinking.



I want to build a work culture where people can communicate openly, ask questions, make mistakes, have boundaries and do good work without everything becoming unnecessarily stressful.



I can be extremely enthusiastic when I’m working on something and sometimes generate ideas faster than they can realistically be implemented. Part of being a good fit for me may actually be being comfortable saying:



“Great idea. Not for today. I’m putting that in the later pile.” 😂



I’m looking for someone who can work with my creativity without either shutting it down or getting swept away by every new idea.



You might be a great fit if you:



* Love untangling messy information

* Enjoy creative brainstorming

* Are organised without needing everything to be rigid

* Can see connections between ideas

* Communicate clearly and honestly

* Are comfortable giving constructive opinions

* Are proactive

* Are curious and like learning new things

* Can work independently once something is clear

* Are comfortable using AI tools

* Have reasonably good visual instincts

* Enjoy figuring out better ways of doing things

* Are comfortable working in a growing business where systems are still being developed



Experience with Canva, Notion or other project-management tools, social media, design, publishing, content creation, creative businesses or AI tools would be useful, but you absolutely do not need experience with all of them.



The role will start at approximately 5 hours per week.



I want to start small, get to know how we work together and gradually increase responsibilities rather than throwing someone into everything immediately.



For the right person, there is plenty of room for the role, hours and responsibilities to grow.



A few questions for your application



Please answer the questions below when you apply.



They’re not trick questions and I’m not looking for perfect answers.



Your responses will help me figure out whether our communication styles and ways of working might mesh well, which is much more important to me than receiving a perfectly polished application.



1. Tell me a little about yourself.



What kind of work have you done before, and what kinds of work do you genuinely enjoy?



2. What would you say are your biggest strengths?



They don’t have to be directly related to this role.



3. What are your weaknesses or areas you don’t feel particularly confident in?



Please answer this honestly.



I actually really value people who understand what they are and aren’t good at. I don’t see having weaknesses as a negative.



4. Imagine I send you a huge messy brain dump.



There are half-finished ideas, random notes, things that contradict each other and probably three completely different projects mixed together.



I say:



“There’s something good in here, but my brain is fried. Can you help me figure out what I’m actually trying to do?”



How would you approach it?



5. If I gave you an idea and you genuinely thought I was making it much more complicated than it needed to be, what would you do?



6. What does good communication between you and the person you work for look like?



7. If you didn’t understand something I asked you to do, how would you handle it?



8. Are you someone who prefers very specific instructions, or do you enjoy being given a goal and figuring out how to get there?



Or somewhere in between?



9. Tell me about something creative you’ve made, organised or helped develop that you’re proud of.



This can be professional or personal.



If you have examples of creative work, Canva designs, resources, social media, documents, workbooks, systems or anything similar, I’d love to see them.



10. What tools or software are you already comfortable using?



And are there any tools you’d particularly like to learn?



11. What is your usual availability?



Please include your time zone, general working hours and how many hours per week you would ideally like if the role expanded.



12. What is your hourly rate?



And finally:



13. What about this particular role made you want to apply?



You absolutely do not need to write an essay for every question.



I’m much more interested in getting a feel for how you think, communicate and work than receiving a formal corporate application.



If this sounds like the strange little intersection between creativity, organisation and problem-solving that your brain enjoys, I’d love to hear from you.

title: We're Hiring: Full-Time Video Editor!
description:
About Us

Alien Prints is a fast-growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois. We produce 200+ orders per month of screen-printed, embroidered, and DTF-transferred custom apparel for construction companies, service businesses, and organizations across the US.



We're searching for a creative and detail-oriented Full-Time Video Editor who can turn ideas into engaging visual content. From social media clips to marketing campaigns, you'll play a key role in creating videos that captivate audiences and elevate our brand.



Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview

title: MUSIC VIDEO EDITOR + COLORIST (RED / Canon, DaVinci Resolve), One Project, Possible Ongoing Work
description:
MUSIC VIDEO EDITOR + COLORIST (RED / Canon, DaVinci Resolve), One Project, Possible Ongoing Work



About the project

I'm Tommy Maples, an award-winning producer and director (Evolve Media, 
). I need an experienced editor and colorist to cut a fun, comedic music video for a country/roots band, shot in a legendary recording studio in Sausalito, California. The song is about 3 minutes.



We shot a full day with two cameras: a RED on Steadicam (R3D, shot in HD), which has most of the footage, and a handheld Canon. The footage is about 500GB on 
. You'll get a detailed storyboard, shotlist, song map and edit guide, so the creative direction is clear. I need someone who can bring it to life, organize it well and make it look great.



What you'll do

- Download about 500GB from 
 and build a clean, well-organized library: bins by scene and camera, clips labeled, selects marked

- Sync both cameras plus playback audio to the final song, including full-song performance takes

- Handle mixed frame rates correctly. Some footage was shot at 48fps while the band performed to the song at 2x speed, so it must be conformed to play back in slow motion while staying in sync. Some footage needs speed ramps

- Cut the music video to the storyboard: performance, cardboard-instrument comedy bits, slow-motion close-ups, and a short story opening and ending

- Match the Canon footage to the RED so they cut together seamlessly, then do a full creative color grade

- Deliver a 16:9 master, plus possible vertical cutdowns for social

- Work through 2 to 3 rounds of revisions on 



Requirements (must have)

- Music video editing experience. Please show at least 2 music videos you edited

- Hands-on experience with RED R3D footage

- Strong color skills in DaVinci Resolve, including matching different cameras. Please show before/after grades

- Experience with high frame rate footage, conforming and speed ramps

- Very organized: clean bins, naming and project structure

- Fast internet: 200 Mbps or faster download. Please include a screenshot from speedtest.net

- A computer that plays R3D smoothly, and at least 2TB of free fast storage for the footage and cache

- Good written English and reliable communication. I'm in California (Pacific Time) and need a few hours of overlap for reviews



Nice to have

- Premiere Pro or Final Cut, in addition to Resolve

- Comedy or narrative editing experience

- Experience with 
 review workflows



Pay

Fixed project fee of $500 to $700 USD depending on experience, plus a $100 bonus for an outstanding final cut. Paid in milestones: library and sync, rough cut, fine cut, final color and delivery. Top candidates will be offered a short paid test edit before hiring. Great work leads to more projects.



How to apply

Put "RED ROCKS" in your subject line so I know you read the whole post. Include:

1. Links to 2 or more music videos you edited, and your role on each

2. A before/after color example, ideally with two different cameras matched

3. Your speedtest.net screenshot

4. Your computer specs (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage) and your DaVinci Resolve version

5. A short answer: a clip was shot at 48fps while the song played at 2x speed. How would you set it up in a 23.976 timeline so it plays in slow motion and stays in sync?

6. Your availability and how many days you'd need for the rough cut



Applications without examples or the subject line won't be reviewed.

title: High-Level Bookkeeper
description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented High-Level Bookkeeper to join our team.



About the Role

This position requires advanced bookkeeping expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to manage complex financial operations across multiple accounts or entities. You will work closely with management to ensure accurate, timely, and clean financial data.



Key Responsibilities

Full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple businesses/entities

Daily transaction review, categorization, and reconciliation

Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR)

Monthly closing and preparation of financial reports

Bank, credit card, loan, and intercompany reconciliations

Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting procedures

Assist with audits, tax preparation, and year-end requirements

Maintain accurate and organized financial records

Collaborate with owners/managers to support operational decisions

description:

 Marketing & Campaigns: Build and send targeted promotional newsletters for special events, seasonal room packages, dining specials, and loyalty promotions.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant
description:
Company: MNJ Trading

Location: Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Working hours: 8:00AM-12NN MANILA TIME



About MNJ Trading



MNJ Trading is an import and export company serving customers throughout the South Pacific region. Our customers operate primarily in the hospitality, industrial, and commercial sectors.



We help customers source suitable products, identify competitive suppliers, prepare quotations, coordinate orders, and arrange delivery to their destination.



About the Role



We are looking for a practical, organized, and detail-oriented Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant.



This is not a role based only on writing
s or speaking confidently. You will be expected to research products, compare suppliers, check specifications, calculate shipping volumes, prepare accurate quotations, follow up on orders, and keep information properly organized.



Our selection process includes a practical work assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the role.



Main Responsibilities:

- Research products based on customer requirements.

- Find and compare suitable suppliers.

- Verify product specifications, pricing, availability, MOQ, lead time, warranty, and delivery conditions.

- Request missing information from suppliers.

- Prepare supplier comparison sheets.

- Calculate carton quantities, weights, dimensions, CBM, and estimated shipping costs.

- Prepare accurate customer quotations.

- Coordinate orders with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and customers.

- Monitor order and shipment progress.

- Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before it becomes a problem.

- Provide clear updates to management and customers.

- Manage several requests according to urgency and commercial importance.



What Good Performance Looks Like



A successful team member:

- Checks details instead of making unsupported assumptions.

- Understands the difference between the lowest price and the best commercial option.

- Can identify when a product does not fully meet the customer’s requirements.

- Uses spreadsheet formulas correctly.

- Keeps source links, calculations, and records easy to verify.

- Communicates delays and problems early.

- Follows instructions and meets deadlines.

- Takes ownership of tasks through completion.

- Asks specific questions when information is missing.

- Produces accurate work without requiring constant supervision.



Required Skills

- Strong online product and supplier research skills.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to compare prices and commercial terms.

- Confidence working with quantities, dimensions, weights, and CBM.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Clear written English.

- Ability to organize files and information.

- Good judgment when handling incomplete or conflicting information.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Experience in procurement, sourcing, logistics, import/export, hospitality supplies, industrial supplies, or quotation preparation is an advantage.



Application Process



The process consists of:

- Initial application review

- MNJ Trading Practical Work Assessment 

- A short interview and live work verification

- Reference checks, if applicable.



Generic cover letters will not receive additional points. We are more interested in clear evidence of how you work.



How to Apply



Please submit:

- Brief Introduction why you're best fit for this role

- One redacted example of a supplier comparison, quotation, logistics spreadsheet, or similar document you personally prepared.



Your answers to the questions below.

1. Describe one product you previously sourced. What information did you verify before recommending a supplier?

2. Tell us about a mistake or discrepancy you found in an invoice, quotation, order, or shipping document. What did you do?

3. If a supplier provides a low price but does not confirm the required specifications, how would you handle it?



Please use the subject line:

Application – Operations Assistant – [Your Full Name]



Applications that progress to the next stage will receive the practical assessment instructions.

Our businesses provide essential plumbing and electrical services to residential customers, property managers and commercial clients.



We are looking for someone who understands that effective accounts receivable management is about more than sending payment reminders.



You must be able to investigate outstanding invoices, understand customer concerns, communicate professionally and confidently secure payment while maintaining positive business relationships.



You will manage an accounts receivable portfolio of approximately AUD $750,000 across the three businesses.



This is a dedicated AR and collections position, not a general administrative VA role.



### What you will be responsible for



**1. Accounts receivable and collections**



* Proactively contact customers regarding outstanding invoices by telephone,
 and SMS.

* Manage aged debt across 30, 60 and 90+ day categories.

* Prioritise accounts based on outstanding value, age, payment history and escalation status.

* Follow up payment commitments and ensure agreed dates are monitored.

* Maintain accurate records of all collection activities.

* Follow our established escalation procedures for overdue accounts.



**2. Invoice and dispute investigation**



* Review job histories, work orders, invoices and customer communications in Ascora.

* Understand the work performed by our plumbing and electrical teams.

* Investigate invoice discrepancies and customer payment concerns.

* Review available job notes, photos, quotations and approval records.

* Liaise with operations and tradespeople to obtain missing information.

* Identify genuine disputes and recommend appropriate resolutions.

* Escalate matters requiring management approval.



**3. Payment allocation and reconciliation**



* Monitor incoming customer payments.

* Allocate payments correctly against outstanding invoices.

* Reconcile customer accounts using Ascora and Xero.

* Investigate unidentified payments and account discrepancies.

* Maintain accurate financial and customer records.

* Ensure all payment arrangements are approved in accordance with company procedures.



**4. Reporting and accountability**



* Prepare regular accounts receivable and aged debt reports.

* Track outstanding balances and collection progress across all three businesses.

* Maintain clear notes and next actions for outstanding accounts.

* Identify high-risk accounts and recommend escalation.

* Provide management with visibility of collection activity, disputes and payment commitments.

* Suggest improvements to our collections processes.



### What we are looking for



**Essential requirements**



* Minimum 3 years of accounts receivable experience working with Australian businesses.

* Demonstrated experience actively collecting outstanding customer payments.

* Excellent conversational English and professional written English.

* Confident communicating with Australian customers by telephone.

* Strong understanding of Australian business communication and customer expectations.

* Experience investigating disputed invoices and resolving payment issues.

* Experience with Xero or comparable accounting software.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and financial accuracy.

* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts independently.

* Strong organisational skills and consistent follow-through.

* Ability to remain professional during difficult customer conversations.

* Reliable internet connection, suitable personal computer and quiet home office.



**Highly regarded**



* Experience working with Australian plumbing, electrical, construction, property management or trade services businesses.

* Previous experience with Ascora, Simpro, ServiceM8 or comparable job management systems.

* Experience reconciling payments across multiple business entities.

* Experience handling complex AR portfolios and commercial accounts.

* Previous experience with debt recovery and formal collection escalation processes.



Ascora training will be provided to the successful applicant.



### The type of person who will succeed



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Is confident making collection calls and following through.

* Can show empathy without avoiding difficult conversations.

* Understands that maintaining customer relationships is just as important as receiving payment.

* Investigates problems before making assumptions.

* Can distinguish a genuine invoice dispute from a delayed payment.

* Keeps accurate records and never leaves outstanding matters without a next action.

* Demonstrates integrity, accountability and strong judgement.

* Communicates clearly and keeps management informed.

* Is motivated by achieving measurable results.



Our company values are Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Communication and Continuous Improvement.



We expect these values to be demonstrated in everyday interactions with our customers and team.



### Systems you will use



* Ascora

* Xero

* Microsoft Outlook / Microsoft 365

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

* Avaya

* Go High Level



Software access and system training will be provided.



### Working arrangements



* Full-time, 40 hours per week.

* Monday to Friday.

* Based in the Philippines, working Australian business hours.

* Standard schedule: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Philippine/Perth time, including a one-hour lunch break.

* Responsibilities across both Perth and Melbourne businesses.

* Work-from-home position.

* You must supply your own computer, reliable internet connection and appropriate home office equipment.



You will work closely with our existing Australian operations and finance teams and report to our nominated management representative.



### What we offer



* Competitive salary of PHP 60,000–75,000 per month, depending on experience.

* Performance bonus opportunity.

* Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing Australian business group.

* Structured training and onboarding.

* Established operating procedures and support from our existing team.

* Opportunity to take ownership of an important business function.

* Professional, supportive and accountable team environment.

* Opportunity to contribute to process improvement as our businesses grow.



### How to apply



We are looking for applicants who have genuine experience working with Australian customers and can demonstrate their communication and collections skills.



Please submit the following:



**1. Your updated CV**



Include your relevant accounts receivable experience, previous Australian employers or clients, and accounting systems used.



**2. A short voice recording (approximately 2 minutes)**



Please introduce yourself and explain:



* Your experience managing accounts receivable for Australian businesses.

* An example of a difficult overdue account you successfully resolved.

* How you approach customers who dispute an invoice.



Please record naturally. We are interested in your actual communication ability, not a scripted presentation.



**3. Written responses**



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked in accounts receivable for Australian businesses?

2. Which accounting and job management systems have you used?

3. What is the largest AR portfolio you have personally managed?

4. How would you approach a customer who disputes an invoice and refuses payment?

5. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP, and when are you available to start?



**Application subject line: AR SPECIALIST – Your Full Name**



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical AR assessment and attend an interview with our team.



We are looking for a long-term team member who takes pride in achieving results, maintaining strong customer relationships and doing things properly.

title: AI Video Editor & Creative Producer – Full-Time
description:
APPLY HERE:





We are hiring a full-time AI Video Editor & Creative Producer for our eight-figure e-commerce brand. This is NOT a traditional video editing role. You must be able to create full AI-powered ad creatives from start to finish.



What you will do:

- Edit full video ad briefs from script to final export (30-
 second ads for
, Instagram, TikTok)

- Generate AI animated clips in 3D/Pixar style for product explainer ads

- Generate AI b-roll video clips using tools like Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo, or similar

- Create AI talking head videos with realistic lip sync using HeyGen, Hedra, or similar

- Generate and edit voiceovers using ElevenLabs or similar voice AI tools

- Create AI static ad images using Nano Banana, Midjourney, or similar

- Design branded frames, overlays, and text animations for ad creatives

- Follow creative briefs provided by our strategist and deliver finished ads independently

- Use our existing product clips and UGC footage alongside AI-generated content



What we are looking for:

- You currently use AI video tools daily — not just experimenting, actually producing content with them

- Proficient in at least 3 of these: Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo, HeyGen, Hedra, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, Midjourney

- Strong video editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Able to take a 30-second script and produce a full ad independently — choosing the right AI clips, b-roll, voiceover, and editing it all together

- Experience creating ads for e-commerce or direct response advertising

- Creative eye — you understand what makes someone stop scrolling

- Fast turnaround — we test a lot of creatives and need someone who can move quickly

- Reliable and able to meet daily deadlines



This is NOT for you if:

- You only know traditional editing (find clips on TikTok, add subtitles, export)

- You've only used ChatGPT for images and nothing else

- You can't show us examples of AI video ads you've actually made



Full-time, 40 hours per week (8 hours daily).

title: Social Media & Marketing Manager – E-Commerce Growth
description:
ABOUT COZAD COMMERCE



Cozad Commerce LLC is a U.S.-based e-commerce company building a multi-store, multi-channel e-commerce portfolio.



We are developing a general online store alongside multiple specialized/niche stores, with sales channels including Shopify, eBay, TikTok Shop, and additional marketplaces as the business grows.



We are hiring our first Social Media & Marketing Manager – E-Commerce Growth to build and own the social media, content, creator/influencer, paid advertising, and digital marketing side of the business from the ground up.



This position will begin part-time at approximately 20–25 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position as the marketing operation, workload, and business revenue grow.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term role who can grow with the company and eventually take greater ownership and leadership responsibility.





ROLE MISSION



This is a hands-on FULL-OWNERSHIP role.



This is a build-from-zero position, not a maintain-what-already-exists position.



You are not being hired simply to make occasional social media posts or wait for the owner to provide a daily task list.



You are being hired to:



BUILD the social media presence → CREATE the content → BUILD the creator/influencer network → RUN paid advertising → DRIVE TRAFFIC → GENERATE SALES → ANALYZE RESULTS → SCALE WHAT WORKS → eventually BUILD AND MANAGE YOUR MARKETING TEAM.



You will be provided with approved company logos, branding, products, business information, and access to the systems needed to perform your role.



You should be comfortable taking those assets and building the actual marketing operation yourself.



Initially, this will be a very hands-on position. As the business grows and the workload justifies additional team members, you will have the opportunity to recommend, help hire, train, and manage specialists underneath you.





BUILD THE SOCIAL MEDIA PRESENCE FROM THE GROUND UP



Many of our social channels will be new or in early stages.



You will be responsible for creating, configuring, connecting, organizing, and managing the appropriate business social media accounts.



This may include:



•

• Instagram

• TikTok

• YouTube

• Pinterest

• Meta Business Suite

• Other appropriate platforms as the brands grow



You will:



• Create business pages/accounts using approved company branding

• Apply approved logos, graphics, bios, descriptions, and brand information

• Establish consistent branding across channels

• Properly configure business profiles

• Connect social channels to the appropriate e-commerce stores and products

• Connect and organize Meta business assets where applicable

• Set up appropriate links, catalogs, tracking, and commerce connections

• Maintain organized account access and documentation

• Ensure each brand/store has a professional and consistent social presence



The owner should not need to manually build every social account before handing it to you.



You will receive the approved branding and direction. You should be capable of turning it into a functioning digital presence.





AI CONTENT & VIDEO CREATION



AI-assisted content creation will be a major part of this position.



We are specifically looking for someone who is comfortable actively creating content with AI — not someone who has simply heard of AI tools.



You will create and manage content including:



• AI-generated product videos

• Short-form product videos

• TikTok videos

• Instagram Reels

•
 content

• YouTube Shorts

• Product demonstrations and concepts

• Promotional videos

• Product images and graphics

• Lifestyle-style product content

• Hooks and captions

• Calls-to-action

• Product launch content

• Promotional campaigns

• Content variations for testing



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Canva

• CapCut

• AI image-generation tools

• AI video-generation tools



Experience with tools such as Sora, Runway, Midjourney, Leonardo, Pika, Veo, or similar AI creative platforms is a strong plus.



You do NOT need experience with every tool listed.



We care more about your ability to use modern AI tools effectively to create quality marketing content at scale.



AI content must still receive human review and quality control. We do not want low-quality automated content published simply for volume.





SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT OWNERSHIP



You will own the day-to-day social content operation.



Responsibilities include:



• Develop social media strategies

• Build content calendars

• Create and schedule posts

• Produce short-form video

• Repurpose successful content across platforms

• Write captions, hooks, and calls-to-action

• Coordinate product launches with the E-Commerce Operations & Growth Manager

• Create content around new and winning products

• Monitor trends and identify content opportunities

• Test different creative concepts

• Maintain an organized content library

• Monitor comments and engagement

• Track content performance

• Identify winning content and create additional variations

• Improve or discontinue content strategies that are not performing

• Establish a consistent content-production cadence



You are expected to own the function — plan, create, publish, engage, analyze, improve, and report — rather than wait for the owner to provide a daily task list.





MICRO-INFLUENCER, CREATOR & UGC OUTREACH



Creator outreach will be a major responsibility.



You will build a repeatable micro-influencer and UGC creator pipeline from the ground up.



Responsibilities include:



• Find relevant micro-influencers and UGC creators

• Research creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other appropriate platforms

• Evaluate audience fit

• Evaluate engagement quality

• Review creator content quality

• Identify creators appropriate for specific products

• Conduct outreach by
, DM, or other appropriate methods

• Follow up consistently

• Coordinate approved product collaborations

• Coordinate affiliate links, creator codes, or commission opportunities where appropriate

• Track creator outreach and responses

• Manage creator communication

• Track agreements and deliverables

• Coordinate deadlines

• Organize creator-generated content

• Track creator links/codes where applicable

• Monitor creator performance

• Identify creators producing meaningful traffic or sales

• Develop longer-term relationships with successful creators



You will continue managing creators after they enter our network.



This means maintaining communication, coordinating campaigns, tracking deliverables, solving routine issues, and identifying which creator relationships should be expanded.



The goal is not simply to contact creators.



The goal is to build a scalable creator network that produces quality content, traffic, customers, and revenue.





PAID ADVERTISING



You will also help build and manage paid advertising as the business begins marketing products.



Experience with e-commerce paid advertising is strongly preferred.



Platforms may include:



• Meta Ads

•
 Ads

• Instagram Ads

• TikTok Ads

• Google Ads / Google Shopping where appropriate

• Retargeting campaigns



Responsibilities may include:



• Build campaigns

• Create and test audiences

• Develop ad creative

• Use AI-assisted creative production

• Test different products

• Test hooks and messaging

• Monitor campaign performance

• Track advertising spend

• Monitor customer acquisition costs

• Monitor ROAS and revenue

• Identify winning creatives and audiences

• Reduce or stop underperforming campaigns

• Scale successful campaigns responsibly



You should understand that advertising performance is measured by business results — not simply clicks, views, or impressions.



Significant advertising-budget decisions will require owner approval, but routine campaign management should increasingly become your responsibility.





WORK WITH THE E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS & GROWTH MANAGER



You will work directly with our E-Commerce Operations & Growth Manager.



The E-Commerce Operations & Growth Manager will primarily own:



• Shopify stores

• Product listings

• Product research and validation

• Marketplace operations

• AutoDS / CJ Dropshipping

• eBay

• TikTok Shop operations

• Inventory

• Suppliers

• Orders

• Fulfillment

• E-commerce operational systems



You will primarily own:



• Social media

• Content

• AI content and video

• Creator/influencer outreach

• UGC

• Paid advertising

• Audience growth

• Marketing analytics

• Customer acquisition



Together, you will:



• Coordinate product launches

• Coordinate store launches

• Identify products showing early traction

• Determine which products deserve additional content or advertising

• Develop creator campaigns around selected products

• Share customer and sales data

• Improve product positioning

• Test offers and creative

• Identify winning products

• Scale successful opportunities

• Build sustainable revenue and profitability



The goal is for Commerce and Marketing to operate together as one growth system.





MEASURE WHAT MATTERS



We are not interested in vanity metrics alone.



Followers, likes, views, and engagement are useful, but this is an e-commerce business.



Marketing should ultimately contribute to customers, revenue, and profitable growth.



You should be comfortable monitoring metrics such as:



• Traffic

• Engagement

• Click-through rate

• Conversion rate

• Revenue

• Customer acquisition cost

• ROAS

• Creator performance

• Affiliate/creator conversions

• Content performance

• Audience growth

• Average order value

• Repeat customer behavior

• Profitability



You should regularly be able to answer:



What is working?



What is not working?



What should we test next?



What should we stop doing?



What should we scale?





BUILD SYSTEMS



As you build the department, you should create repeatable systems for:



• Content creation

• Content scheduling

• AI content production

• Creator research

• Creator outreach

• Creator management

• Paid advertising

• Performance tracking

• Content libraries

• Reporting

• SOPs

• QA

• Marketing analytics



We want someone who naturally asks:



“Can this be automated, systemized, delegated, tested faster, or made more efficient?”





BUILD YOUR TEAM AS THE BUSINESS GROWS



Initially, YOU will be hands-on.



You should be comfortable personally creating content, posting, reaching out to creators, managing creators, launching campaigns, analyzing results, and helping build the marketing operation.



We are not hiring a manager to immediately delegate all execution to employees who do not yet exist.



As workload and revenue grow, you may reach a point where doing all of the manual execution yourself is no longer the best use of your time.



At that point, you may recommend additional team members.



Potential future roles could include:



• Social Media / Content Specialist

• Creator & UGC Outreach Specialist

• Video Editor / Creative Specialist

• Paid Advertising Specialist

• Affiliate Marketing Specialist



You may help:



• Define the positions

• Recruit candidates

• Interview candidates

• Participate in hiring decisions

• Train new team members

• Build SOPs

• Delegate work

• Establish KPIs

• Monitor performance

• Manage the marketing team



The progression is:



DO THE WORK → BUILD THE SYSTEM → PROVE WHAT WORKS → SCALE → HIRE SUPPORT → MANAGE THE DEPARTMENT.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means:



• Our social media accounts are professionally built and operating

• Social channels are properly connected to our e-commerce ecosystem

• Quality content is being produced consistently

• AI is being used effectively to increase content speed and creative output

• Micro-influencer and UGC outreach is happening consistently

• Creator relationships are being actively managed

• Creator content is being collected and used effectively

• Paid advertising is being tested and optimized responsibly

• Marketing is producing measurable traffic and customer activity

• Winning content, products, creators, and campaigns are identified

• Successful opportunities are scaled

• Marketing contributes to measurable revenue

• Marketing systems become increasingly repeatable and organized

• Routine owner involvement decreases as the department becomes established

• Additional team members are added when justified by workload and growth



The owner should primarily be involved for strategic direction, significant approvals, major budget decisions, major brand decisions, or genuine escalations.



Speed matters.



We want the marketing operation built and producing measurable results as efficiently as possible while maintaining brand quality, platform compliance, customer experience, and operational accuracy.





COMPENSATION & GROWTH



Starting Pay: $7–$8 USD/hour depending on experience

Starting Hours: Approximately 20–25 hours/week

Employment: Part-time initially, with opportunity to grow into full-time

Pay Schedule: Weekly

Position: Long-term



This position is intentionally starting part-time while the marketing operation is being built.



As the e-commerce stores, marketing workload, and revenue grow, there will be an opportunity to increase hours and potentially transition into a full-time position.



Fast-track compensation growth is available based on demonstrated performance, successful execution, meaningful traffic and audience growth, successful creator partnerships, revenue contribution, paid advertising performance, increased responsibility, and overall business growth.



Additional opportunities may include:



• Performance-based bonuses for exceptional measurable results

• Compensation increases as revenue, profitability, responsibility, and performance grow

• Increased leadership responsibility

• Opportunity to build and manage your own marketing team

• Potential advancement into Senior Social Media & Marketing Manager / Head of Marketing



Compensation growth is results-driven — not based solely on time in the position.





ADDITIONAL BUSINESS GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



The primary focus of this position will be Cozad Commerce and our e-commerce stores.



As the role and broader business portfolio grow, there may also be opportunities to support social media, creator outreach, and marketing initiatives for other businesses within our portfolio, including Cozad Customs LLC.



Expanded responsibilities would come with corresponding opportunities for additional hours, compensation, leadership, and advancement.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



We are looking for hands-on experience preferably including several of the following:



• Social media management

• E-commerce marketing

•

• Instagram

• TikTok

• YouTube Shorts

• Content creation

• Short-form video

• AI video/content creation

• Canva

• CapCut or similar video editing

• Creator/influencer outreach

• UGC coordination

• Affiliate marketing

• Creator management

• Meta Ads

• TikTok Ads

• Google Ads / Google Shopping

• Shopify

• TikTok Shop

• Meta Business Suite

• Marketing analytics

• Content calendars

• Product marketing

• SOP/process development

• AI tools

• Automation
