title: Recruiter
description:
AGENDA INSIDER — RECRUITER IN THE PHILIPPINES



Agenda Insider is a U.S. software and construction-intelligence

company. We monitor city planning and zoning meetings across

American counties and alert construction-related businesses to

development projects — often months before construction begins.



Our customers are excavation contractors, builders, title

companies and lenders. Our initial markets are Utah, Nevada and

Arizona.



We are building a small team of part-time outbound callers in the

Philippines. Before hiring the callers, we are hiring one

excellent recruiter to find them.



This is a recruiting role. You will not be making sales calls

yourself.



───────────────────────────────

WHAT THE CALLERS ACTUALLY DO



This is a factual, low-pressure business conversation — not a

hard-sell campaign and not a scam call.



The caller introduces three real construction or development

projects recently discussed in the prospect's own area. Depending

on the project, that includes the location, acreage, proposed use,

number of homes or units, and the date it appeared before a

planning commission.



Then one simple question:



    "Had you already heard about that project?"



And then:



    "We track dozens — even hundreds — of projects like these as

     they begin emerging in your area. Would you be open to a

     fifteen-minute demonstration so you can see what we're

     finding?"



That is the whole purpose of the call: create interest and

schedule a demonstration.



The research, project information, script and training are all

provided. Callers follow the approved message while sounding

natural. They must never invent facts, make unsupported claims,

pressure a prospect, or imply they represent a city or government

agency.



───────────────────────────────

THE SCHEDULE — SCREEN FOR THIS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE



The calling window is 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM U.S. Mountain Time.

Four hours, Monday through Friday.



In the Philippines that is a late-evening or overnight shift, and

the corresponding Philippines hours shift when U.S.

daylight-saving time changes.



Every candidate must understand and genuinely accept this before

you present them. More outbound hires fail on schedule than on

skill, and a caller who quits in week two costs us far more than

one we never hired.



───────────────────────────────

WHO WE NEED YOU TO FIND



  • Excellent spoken English — clear, natural, and easy for an

    American business owner to follow over the telephone. This is

    the first filter and nearly everything else is negotiable.

  • Listens and responds conversationally rather than reading.

  • Confident with owners and managers of construction companies,

    many of whom answer their own phones.

  • Calm, steady and curious. Not aggressive, not pushy.

  • Dependable attendance, and willing to take coaching from

    recorded-call feedback.

  • Reliable internet, suitable equipment, quiet place to work.



Previous call-center, appointment-setting or outbound sales

experience helps but is not required. Attitude, reliability,

listening ability and spoken English matter more than an

impressive BPO résumé.



───────────────────────────────

YOUR ASSIGNMENT



Find, evaluate and help us hire two outstanding part-time callers.



We are not hiring someone to collect résumés. Your assignment is

complete when two hires have finished our training and are still

performing well after 30 days — not when you deliver a shortlist.



You will:



  • Source candidates through OnlineJobs.ph,
 groups,

    referrals, your existing network, and anywhere else you have

    real reach.

  • Screen spoken English yourself, in a live conversation. Not

    from a résumé, not from a written application.

  • Evaluate voice clarity, listening ability, confidence, warmth,

    judgment and professionalism.

  • Run a short role-play using a script we provide, and judge

    whether they sound human reading it.

  • Confirm schedule acceptance, internet, equipment and

    workspace.

  • Present five genuinely strong finalists with candid written

    notes — including what is weak about each one.

  • Coordinate and sit in on our final interviews.

  • Help us replace anyone who proves unreliable or does not

    complete training.



───────────────────────────────

COMPENSATION



  • An hourly rate for your approved recruiting work.

  • A success bonus for each caller we hire who completes training

    and is still working well after 30 days.



I would rather pay more for people who perform and stay than pay

less for a large pile of résumés.



Please propose the hourly rate and retention-bonus structure you

believe is fair. Terms are discussed with shortlisted applicants.



This begins as a focused project for two calling seats. If the

campaign succeeds we expect to hire more as Agenda Insider expands

into additional U.S. markets, and the right recruiter becomes a

continuing partner.



───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that skip any step will

not receive a response.



1. Begin your application with the word DIRT.



2. Provide a link to a voice recording of no more than 60 seconds

   answering:



   "Tell me about a person you recruited who did not work out.

    What did you miss during the hiring process?"



   Vocaroo, Loom, Google Drive, Dropbox or any accessible service.

   Please confirm the link works before you send it. You will be

   judging other people's spoken English, so we need to hear

   yours.



3. In two or three sentences, in your own words:



   "How would you test whether someone's spoken English is strong

    enough to speak with an American construction-company owner on

    the telephone?"



   There is no single correct answer. I want to understand how you

   evaluate people.



4. Tell me two things: where and how you would look for these

   callers beyond waiting for applications to this posting, and

   the most similar recruiting assignment you have completed —

   including what happened to the people you hired.



Do not send a generic cover letter. I will personally read every

application that follows these instructions, and none that does

not.

title: Full-Time Full-Stack Developer | Next.js, Supabase & WordPress Integrations
description:
Southwind Marketing is a U.S.-based marketing and technology agency looking for an experienced full-stack developer in the Philippines to help build and maintain our branded client and staff platform.



This is a full-time, long-term opportunity. You will help deliver the initial release, build new modules in phases, maintain integrations, and improve the platform as our agency and client base grow.



We are not looking for someone to simply complete tickets. We need a developer who can understand the platform architecture, investigate technical limitations, recommend practical solutions, and take ownership of implementation.



About the Platform



Our clients currently work through account managers for website updates, support requests, project coordination, approvals, files, reporting, and communication.



We are bringing those activities into one secure client portal where clients can:



Request support and website changes

Track projects and tasks

Communicate with staff

Share files

Review reports

Approve work

Edit approved website content

Receive notifications and updates



The platform must also support marketing, consulting, and other clients who may not have a website hosted with Southwind.



Our preferred stack is:



Next.js

React

TypeScript

PostgreSQL

Supabase



An unfinished repository already exists. One of your first responsibilities will be reviewing the existing codebase and determining what should be reused, improved, or rebuilt.



Initial Development Priorities



The first release will include:



 login, invitations, and password recovery

Branded client dashboards

Agency administrator, staff, contractor, and client roles

Clients, projects, tasks, deadlines, assignments, and discussions

Support requests and ticket workflows

Private internal notes

Contractor access limited to assigned work

Client onboarding and offboarding workflows

Checklists and asset collection

Private file storage

Manually uploaded reports

Approval workflows

Version-specific approvals

Comments and requested changes

Approval reminders and decision history

In-app notifications

 notifications

Audit history

WordPress Integration



Our client websites primarily use:



WordPress

Elementor Pro

Advanced Custom Fields

Cloudways hosting



Clients should eventually be able to edit approved website content through the portal without accessing the full WordPress administration area.



This includes approved:



Text

Images

Links

Custom fields

Existing page and post content



Layouts, templates, global styles, and other protected design elements must remain restricted.



You will review representative staging websites, document supported Elementor widgets, templates, and ACF fields, and develop the connector/API functionality required.



The initial release will focus on editing existing pages and posts. More advanced content creation can be added later.



Security & Permissions



Security is a major part of this role.



You should be comfortable implementing:



PostgreSQL Row Level Security

Server-side authorization

Agency → client → project → assignment access boundaries

Private file permissions

Role-based access controls

Privileged-user MFA

Audit logging

Access revocation

Secure file URLs

Authorization checks for background jobs and notifications

Automated tests proving users cannot access another client’s information



Permissions must be enforced at the database and server level, not only in the user interface.



Future Development



After the initial release, planned phases may include:



Social media content planning

Client approvals for social content

Scheduling and publishing workflows

Reporting

GoHighLevel integration

CRM and onboarding workflows

Reusable project templates

Recurring tasks and work

Advanced intake forms

Workflow automation

Expanded website editing

Website and domain management records

Google sign-in

 sign-in

Google Drive connections

Future reseller branding

Multi-agency support



These features will be developed in stages.



Third-party API capabilities must be verified before implementation. Existing CRM, phone routing, automations, and client systems must not be disrupted.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Reviewing the existing repository

Technical architecture and implementation

Front-end and back-end development

Database design

API integrations

WordPress connector development

Testing

Deployment

Security

Documentation

Bug fixes

Ongoing platform improvements

Regular Git commits

Staging demonstrations

Backup and recovery procedures



Code and infrastructure will remain within accounts controlled by Southwind Marketing.



Documentation should be detailed enough that another qualified developer could understand and continue the project.



Required Experience



We are looking for someone with:



Proven experience building production web applications, SaaS products, or client portals

Strong Next.js experience

Strong React experience

Strong TypeScript experience

Strong PostgreSQL experience

Strong Supabase experience

Experience implementing Supabase Row Level Security

WordPress development experience

PHP experience

WordPress REST API experience

Custom WordPress plugin development

Elementor experience

ACF experience

API and webhook integration experience

Experience building role-based permissions

Experience with approval workflows

Experience with private file storage

Git and repository management experience

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Communication



You must have:



Strong written English

Clear spoken English

Reliable communication

Ability to explain technical issues in plain language

Ability to communicate blockers early

Ability to manage milestones independently

Some working-hours overlap with U.S. Central Time

Schedule



This is a full-time position.



The initial goal is to deliver a working first release within approximately 90 days. The final schedule will be agreed after you review the repository, technical scope, and acceptance requirements.



This is not a 90-day contract. Development will continue after the initial release as we add additional modules, integrations, and improvements.



To Apply



Please provide:



Two or three relevant web applications, SaaS platforms, or client portals you have worked on

A clear explanation of your personal contribution to each project

Your experience with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Supabase

Your experience implementing Supabase Row Level Security

Your WordPress, Elementor, ACF, and custom plugin experience

Your experience integrating WordPress with external applications

Your experience building approval workflows or granular permission systems

A brief explanation of how you would approach reviewing an unfinished codebase before continuing development

Your current availability

Your earliest possible start date

Your expected monthly compensation in USD

Whether you will personally perform all development work or whether any other developers would be involved



Please include examples that demonstrate actual application functionality, permissions, integrations, or dashboards. Website design examples alone are not sufficient for this position.



Begin your application with:



SOUTHWIND FULL STACK



so we know you read the entire posting.



For the OnlineJobs.ph fields, I’d use Full Time and probably list the three skills as Full-Stack Development, React/Next.js, and WordPress Development if those are available.



$11/hour to start, with room to increase based on experience and performance.

title: Part-Time Management Accountant / QuickBooks Advisor
description:
We are looking for an experienced Management Accountant / QuickBooks Online Advisor to assist our hospitality and property business for approximately 5–10 hours per week.



We already have a bookkeeper handling much of the day-to-day accounting work.



This role is the next level above bookkeeping.



We are looking for someone who can review what is already in QuickBooks, clean up problems, assist with VAT reporting, provide accounting guidance, and help us better understand the performance of the business.



We operate a resort and hospitality business in Vanuatu, with several related entities covering accommodation, restaurant operations and property-owner accounting.



What we need help with



The initial work will mainly involve reviewing and cleaning up our existing QuickBooks Online accounts.



This may include:



Reviewing historical transactions and identifying errors



Cleaning up duplicated or incorrectly posted transactions



Reviewing the chart of accounts



Checking how transactions are being classified



Reviewing bank and balance-sheet reconciliations



Helping correct historical accounting issues



Reviewing work completed by our existing bookkeeper



Assisting with month-end and year-end adjustments



Helping with VAT returns and VAT reconciliations



Checking that VAT has been treated correctly



Reviewing inter-company and related-party transactions



Helping establish better accounting procedures and controls



We previously experimented with automatically transferring sales information into QuickBooks, which resulted in some duplicated and incorrectly classified transactions. One of the first projects will be helping us clean this up properly.



Management accounting and business insights



We are also looking for someone who can go beyond simply processing transactions.



We would like help understanding questions such as:



How is the business actually performing?



Are margins improving or declining?



Are expenses moving outside normal levels?



Which areas of the business are performing well?



Are there unusual transactions that should be investigated?



How does the current month compare with previous months and previous years?



Is cash flow improving or deteriorating?



Are there accounting issues that management should be aware of?



You do not need to prepare complicated reports every week.



We are looking for someone who can look at the accounts and occasionally say:



“I noticed this — you should probably have a closer look at it.”



That type of insight would be very valuable to us.



VAT experience



Experience with VAT, GST or similar consumption taxes is important.



Our businesses are based in Vanuatu, so you do not necessarily need previous Vanuatu VAT experience.



However, you should have a strong understanding of:



Output VAT / VAT collected



Input VAT / VAT credits



VAT reconciliations



Reviewing VAT returns



Correct treatment of purchases and sales



Identifying transactions where VAT may have been treated incorrectly



We can explain any specific Vanuatu rules where necessary.



QuickBooks Online



You should be highly experienced with QuickBooks Online.



We are not looking for someone who needs to learn QuickBooks after being hired.



Ideally you will have:



4+ years accounting experience



Strong QuickBooks Online experience



Experience cleaning up existing QuickBooks files



Strong reconciliation skills



Experience preparing or reviewing VAT/GST returns



Good understanding of management accounts



Ability to review a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet and identify unusual items



Good Excel or Google Sheets skills



Strong written English



Good judgement and attention to detail



CPA, CA or equivalent accounting qualifications would be an advantage, but practical experience is more important to us than qualifications alone.



Experience with hospitality, hotels, restaurants, property management or multi-entity businesses would also be useful.



AI and automation



We are interested in gradually using AI to improve efficiency.



Over time, we would like to investigate using tools such as:



ChatGPT



Claude



QuickBooks reporting



Excel / Google Sheets



Zapier



Make



Other accounting automation tools



This could eventually help with things such as:



Management reporting



Owner reporting



Reviewing transactions



Identifying unusual entries



Comparing monthly results



Extracting information from accounting data



Reducing repetitive administrative work



You do not need to be an AI expert.



We are mainly looking for someone who is curious, practical and willing to help us gradually improve the system.



How we like to work



We prefer people who investigate problems before immediately asking questions.



If you encounter an accounting issue, ideally you would come back to us with something like:



“I have looked into this. This is what I think happened, these are the transactions involved, and this is how I recommend we correct it.”



We are happy to answer questions where necessary, but we are looking for someone capable of working independently and applying good accounting judgement.



Hours



Initially approximately:



5–10 hours per week



Hours are flexible.



This would suit an experienced accountant who already has another role or other clients but has some spare capacity each week.



There may be additional hours available from time to time.



Pay



Please advise your expected hourly rate in USD.



We are looking for good value, but we are not simply looking for the cheapest applicant.



We would rather pay more for someone who genuinely understands accounting and QuickBooks and can work efficiently without requiring constant supervision.



How to apply



Please begin your application with:



MANGOES ACCOUNTANT



Then answer the following questions:



What accounting qualification do you have, if any?



How many years of accounting experience do you have?



How many years have you personally used QuickBooks Online?



Have you previously cleaned up an existing QuickBooks file? Please briefly explain what was wrong and how you corrected it.



What experience do you have preparing or reviewing VAT or GST returns?



Are you comfortable reviewing a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet and identifying unusual or incorrect items?



Have you worked with multiple companies or related entities?



Have you worked in hospitality, property management, restaurants or hotels?



What experience do you have with Excel or Google Sheets?



Have you used ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools for accounting or analysis?



What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



How many hours per week are you available?



Are you currently employed or working with other clients?



Please do not send a generic application simply saying that you are an expert.



We are looking for someone with genuine practical accounting experience who can demonstrate how they think and solve accounting problems.



For the right person, this could develop into a long-term role supporting management and our existing bookkeeping team.

title: International Construction Sourcing & Procurement Specialist
description:
Technical Sourcing & Construction Specification Analysis



Ability to review and interpret architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings; construction specifications; Bills of Quantities (BOQ); Bills of Materials (BOM); scopes of work; material submittals; and project requirements. Evaluate supplier and manufacturer quotations to ensure proposed materials and products meet project specifications, applicable standards, and performance requirements while allowing accurate apple-to-apple commercial comparison.



International Material Sourcing & Supplier Identification



Ability to identify, evaluate, and develop qualified domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers for construction materials, building products, equipment, and selected finishes. Conduct global market research to identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities from the United States and international markets while considering material quality, technical compliance, production capacity, shipping requirements, tariffs and duties, customs clearance, lead times, and overall supply-chain risk.



Potential sourcing categories may include structural steel and miscellaneous metals, reinforcing steel, precast products, doors and windows, architectural finishes, flooring, cabinetry, plumbing fixtures, electrical products, lighting, HVAC-related materials, site-development materials, drainage products, geosynthetics, landscaping materials, and other construction-related products where international procurement can provide measurable cost advantages.



Value Engineering & Material Cost Optimization



Ability to review specified materials and construction requirements and identify fit-for-purpose alternatives that reduce project cost without compromising structural integrity, safety, durability, quality, code compliance, aesthetics, or required performance. Work with project management, estimating, design teams, engineers, architects, subcontractors, and owners to evaluate alternative manufacturers, equivalent products, material substitutions, standardized specifications, and other value-engineering opportunities.



Construction Material Compliance & Product Qualification



Ability to verify that proposed domestic and imported construction materials comply with project specifications, approved plans, applicable building codes, and relevant industry standards such as ASTM, ANSI, ACI, AISC, UL, NFPA, and other standards required by the project. Coordinate technical data sheets, certificates, laboratory test reports, samples, shop drawings, product certifications, warranties, and other documentation required for material approval and construction submittals.



Supplier & Manufacturer Capability Assessment



Ability to assess supplier and manufacturer capabilities, including production facilities, equipment, technical competency, capacity, quality-control procedures, certifications, testing capabilities, manufacturing lead times, export experience, packaging methods, and ability to consistently meet project schedules and quality requirements. Conduct or coordinate supplier prequalification, factory evaluations, third-party inspections, and quality verification when appropriate.



Strategic Sourcing & Construction Procurement



Working knowledge of the complete sourcing and procurement process, including material takeoffs and procurement planning, market scanning, supplier identification, RFQ/RFP preparation, bid solicitation, supplier qualification, quotation analysis, negotiation, purchase recommendations, purchase orders, manufacturing monitoring, delivery coordination, supplier development, and supplier performance management.



Develop sourcing strategies that balance domestic purchasing with international procurement based on project requirements, cost savings, schedule considerations, material availability, quality, and supply-chain risk.



Technical-Commercial Bid Evaluation



Ability to perform comprehensive apple-to-apple comparisons of supplier and manufacturer proposals by considering technical compliance, unit pricing, quantities, freight, packaging, insurance, tariffs, customs duties, taxes, payment terms, Incoterms, production lead time, shipping duration, minimum order quantities, warranties, inspection requirements, replacement risks, and supplier reliability.



Evaluate suppliers based on Total Landed Cost and Total Cost of Ownership, rather than material purchase price alone, to determine whether domestic or international sourcing provides the greatest overall value to the company and project.



International Logistics & Landed-Cost Analysis



Ability to coordinate and evaluate international procurement requirements including Incoterms, freight forwarding, container utilization, consolidation, port handling, customs documentation, import duties, tariffs, brokerage, inland transportation, cargo insurance, warehousing, and delivery to project sites in Nashville, Tennessee and other company project locations.



Prepare landed-cost analyses comparing international sourcing against domestic suppliers to determine actual project savings after all transportation, importation, handling, storage, quality-control, and schedule-related costs are considered.



Negotiation & Commercial Acumen



Ability to develop and execute supplier negotiation strategies using cost analysis, supplier competition, historical pricing, international market intelligence, commodity trends, volume leverage, project pipelines, payment terms, alternative materials, manufacturing efficiencies, freight consolidation, and long-term supplier relationships.



Capable of negotiating pricing, minimum order quantities, production schedules, freight responsibilities, warranties, payment structures, quality requirements, replacement provisions, and other commercial terms with both U.S.-based and international suppliers.



Construction Spend & Global Market Intelligence



Ability to analyze company and project procurement spend, material consumption, supplier concentration, commodity pricing, construction-material trends, freight conditions, currency considerations, tariffs, industry benchmarks, and alternative manufacturing markets.



Identify categories where global sourcing, supplier consolidation, bulk purchasing, project bundling, framework agreements, or direct-from-manufacturer purchasing may generate meaningful savings across multiple building and land-development projects.



Contract, Purchase Order & Commercial Terms Management



Working knowledge of supplier purchase agreements, purchase orders, payment terms, deposits, letters of credit or other international payment arrangements, warranties, liabilities, insurance requirements, delivery obligations, inspection requirements, quality provisions, confidentiality agreements, Incoterms, cancellation provisions, delay responsibilities, and other commercial terms relevant to domestic and international construction procurement.



Put Contract - Procurement Specialist in the subject if you are really reading it.



Ensure purchasing agreements clearly define required specifications, quantities, quality standards, documentation, delivery milestones, inspection procedures, warranty obligations, and remedies for defective, non-compliant, damaged, or delayed materials.



Quality Assurance & Pre-Shipment Inspection



Ability to establish quality-control requirements for internationally sourced construction materials, including approved samples, mock-ups, factory production inspections, laboratory testing, certificates of compliance, third-party inspections, pre-shipment verification, packaging inspection, and documentation review.



Coordinate with project teams to ensure imported materials are technically approved before production and adequately inspected before shipment to minimize the risk of receiving non-compliant materials after arrival in the United States.



Procurement Scheduling & Long-Lead Material Management



Ability to integrate procurement activities with construction schedules by identifying long-lead materials, required submittal dates, manufacturing durations, inspection timelines, ocean or air freight durations, customs-clearance requirements, and required-on-site dates.



Maintain procurement tracking systems and proactively identify schedule risks so that cost savings obtained through international sourcing do not negatively affect construction milestones or project completion dates.



Supply Risk Management & Problem Solving



Ability to identify and resolve supplier, manufacturing, quality, shipping, customs, delivery, billing, capacity, and technical-commercial issues. Develop contingency sourcing strategies and alternative suppliers for critical materials to reduce dependency on a single manufacturer or country of origin.



Evaluate procurement risks associated with international sourcing, including shipping delays, port congestion, currency fluctuations, tariffs, geopolitical disruptions, manufacturing quality, supplier financial stability, product damage, replacement lead times, and changes in project schedules.



Cross-Functional Construction Coordination

title: Expert Interview: Philippines LPG Market & Industry Outlook
description:
We are currently conducting research on the LPG industry in the Philippines and are looking for an experienced industry professional for a 1-hour paid expert interview.



We are seeking someone with practical, hands-on experience and knowledge of the Philippine LPG industry, preferably from an LPG company, distributor, energy company, industry association, or other relevant organization.



Discussion Topics:

■ LPG Market Overview – LPG consumption by customer segment, major players, and future growth trends

■ LPG Business Structure – Retail/distribution business models, supply sources (imported vs. domestically produced), and profit structure across the value chain

■ Regulations & Licensing – Required licenses, permits, documentation, application procedures, and safety/fire-related requirements

■ Business Practices – General business practices in the Philippines and key considerations when dealing with PEZA-registered companies

■ Energy Market Opportunities – LNG projects and policies, as well as industries and regions with strong growth potential



Ideal Candidate:

Practical experience in the Philippine LPG industry

Good understanding of the LPG market and business structure

Able to discuss industry practices and regulatory requirements based on actual experience

Current or former industry professionals are welcome



Interview Format: Online

Duration: Approximately 1 hour

Compensation: Paid interview – fee to be discussed based on experience



If you have relevant experience and are interested, please send us:



Your current/previous role and company/industry

Brief summary of your LPG-related experience

Relevant areas of expertise

Your expected fee for a 1-hour interview

Your availability

title: EXPERT FUNNELISH BUILDER — DROPSHIPPING / ISRAELI MARKET
description:
# EXPERT FUNNELISH BUILDER — DROPSHIPPING / ISRAELI MARKET



**Position:** Expert Funnelish Funnel Builder

**Job Type:** Long-Term / On-Demand

**Workload:** Up to 2 funnels per day

**Schedule:** Flexible, but must be available when assigned work

**Location:** Remote

**Pay:** Negotiable based on proven experience and quality



## We Are Looking for a TRUE Funnelish Expert



We are looking for an **experienced Funnelish expert** who has **PROVEN experience building high-converting funnels for successful dropshipping/e-commerce brands**.



This is not a position for someone who needs constant training or step-by-step instructions.



We need someone who can receive a funnel assignment, understand what needs to be done, and **build a high-quality funnel quickly and independently**.



Our main focus is the **Israeli market**, so experience with Israeli e-commerce and Hebrew/RTL funnels is a major advantage.



---



## WHAT WE EXPECT



We need someone who can realistically handle **up to 2 funnels per day** when there is enough work.



You should be able to:



* Build complete funnels in Funnelish

* Recreate/adapt proven funnel structures

* Build landing pages and product pages

* Build checkout pages

* Create order bumps

* Create upsells/downsell flows

* Build mobile-first funnels

* Work with Hebrew and RTL layouts when needed

* Make funnels look professional and trustworthy

* Follow our instructions accurately

* Make smart improvements when you see something that can be improved

* Complete assigned funnels within the agreed timeframe



You should **NOT** need someone constantly checking your work or telling you what to do next.



---



# ⚠️ RELIABILITY & AVAILABILITY ARE VERY IMPORTANT



This position is for someone we can **rely on long-term**.



We frequently need funnels built on demand, so when we contact you with work, you need to be reasonably available and able to start/work within the agreed timeframe.



We are NOT looking for someone who:



* Disappears for days

* Frequently has internet problems

* Is constantly unavailable

* Has unreliable electricity/internet without a backup solution

* Takes several days to complete work that should take hours

* Needs to be reminded repeatedly

* Is working with so many other clients that they cannot prioritize our projects



### You MUST have:



✅ **Fast and stable internet/Wi-Fi**

✅ A reliable computer capable of handling Funnelish and related tools

✅ A backup internet solution is a BIG plus

✅ Consistent availability

✅ Good communication

✅ Ability to respond when work is assigned

✅ Ability to handle multiple funnels when needed

✅ A quiet/workable environment where you can actually focus

✅ Reliable electricity/power, ideally with a backup solution



**Before hiring, we may ask you to provide an internet speed test.**



---



# PROVEN RESULTS ARE REQUIRED



We are NOT interested in simply hearing:



> "I have 3 years of Funnelish experience."



We want to **SEE what you have built.**



When applying, you MUST provide:



### 1. At least 3 real Funnelish funnels you personally built



Send us:



* Funnel links

* Screenshots

* Loom/video walkthroughs

* Portfolio examples



### 2. Tell us the results



For each funnel, provide whatever data you are allowed to share:



* Conversion rate

* AOV

* Revenue

* ROAS

* Upsell take rate

* Checkout conversion

* Add-to-cart rate

* Number of orders

* Traffic volume



If you cannot share confidential numbers, explain the results without revealing sensitive information.



### 3. Dropshipping experience



Tell us specifically:



* What dropshipping brands/products you worked with

* What type of funnels you built

* What your role was

* Whether you personally built the funnel inside Funnelish



### 4. Israeli market experience



If you have built funnels for Israel before, **this is a major advantage**.



Tell us:



* Which Israeli brands/products you worked with

* Whether the funnels were Hebrew

* Whether you worked with RTL design

* Whether you understand Israeli consumers

* Any results you achieved



---



# IMPORTANT: WE WANT A FUNNEL BUILDER, NOT JUST A DESIGNER



A beautiful funnel that doesn't convert is not useful to us.



We want someone who understands:



**Traffic → Hook → Offer → Landing Page → Product Page → Checkout → Order Bump → Upsell → AOV → Profit**



You should understand **why** each part of a funnel exists and how to optimize it.



---



# WORKING STYLE



We will give you assignments as needed.



For example:



**"We need this product funnel built today."**



You should be able to take the information, understand the requirements, build the funnel, and deliver it within the agreed timeframe.



When workload is high, we may need **2 funnels completed in a day**.



We care about:



**Speed + Quality + Reliability + Conversion**



Not just how many years you've been doing this.



---



# THIS CAN BECOME LONG-TERM WORK



If you prove that you are:



* Fast

* Reliable

* Highly skilled

* Easy to communicate with

* Able to consistently produce quality funnels

* Available when we need you



There is potential for **consistent long-term work and increased compensation based on performance and responsibility.**



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with:



**"I AM A FUNNELISH EXPERT"**



Then answer ALL of the following:



**1. How many years have you been using Funnelish?**



**2. How many Funnelish funnels have you personally built?**



**3. Send us at least 3 real funnels you personally built.**



**4. What were the results of those funnels?**



**5. How much experience do you have with dropshipping?**



**6. Have you built funnels specifically for the Israeli market? If yes, explain.**



**7. Can you build Hebrew / RTL funnels?**



**8. Can you handle up to 2 funnels per day when required?**



**9. What is your typical availability when we assign you a funnel?**



**10. What is your internet speed? Please provide a speed-test screenshot/link.**



**11. Do you have backup internet if your main connection goes down?**



**12. Do you have backup power/electricity if there is a power outage?**



**13. Are you currently working with other clients? If yes, how many?**



**14. What hours/time zone are you normally available?**



**15. How quickly can you normally start a new funnel assignment?**



**16. What is your expected rate?**



### IMPORTANT:



**Applications without real Funnelish examples will NOT be considered.**



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of our team for the long term — not someone looking for occasional freelance work.



If you are genuinely excellent at Funnelish and have **proof that your funnels work**, we want to hear from you.

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type of Work: Full-time | Hours: 40/week | Shift: Fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri

Compensation: $1,200–$2,000/month base + placement-linked bonus

Company: Talent Staffing and Recruiting — a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health, expanding into new verticals



JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



REQUIRED



4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There will be a detailed walkthrough in the interview.

Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there's a live spoken check.

Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



Do NOT apply if:



Your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill).

You've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork.

You cannot name specific placements you personally closed.

Your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals, or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: You run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

Name ONE placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. (Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)

Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a 30–60 sec voice intro (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

Scenario: you inherit ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters, with a ~20% fill rate. In 5–8 sentences, walk us through your first 30 days and the number you'd commit to for day 90.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9 PM–6 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? What's your home setup (internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power)?

Current/most recent monthly pay, earliest start date, and a short (30–60 sec) voice intro — introduce yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our ENTIRE delivery organization. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder — every recruiting lane, every recruiter, and the company-wide fill number are yours.



This is a staffing-agency delivery leadership seat, not a corporate HR/TA role. You inherit a live board of open US jobs and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager), and you are accountable for one thing: jobs filled. You set the per-req fill strategy across the whole board, install the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're a lean firm, you still personally recruit on the hardest, highest-value searches.



Responsibilities

- Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, kill or escalate stalled searches honestly.

- Lead the whole delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run the daily cadence, set quality-gated submittal standards per recruiter, and manage performance to them.

- Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

- Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

- Report the truth to the founder weekly with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 6+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, with 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements — agency/staffing-firm side (BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms count; in-house corporate TA does not). Leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

- US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements (role, US state, salary) and walk through exactly how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen US healthcare professionals and coach everyone who does; live spoken check included.

- Fluent with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and delivery metrics; can build a KPI dashboard, not just read one.

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership is in-house corporate TA/HR (not agency delivery); you've led sourcing/CV-mining teams only and never owned submittals-to-fill; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US clinicians; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: the whole delivery organization is yours — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy, standards, and team build-out, competitive director-level base plus a placement-linked bonus tied to the fills your org produces, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. The largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, total headcount (and layers — did team leads/managers report to you?), what the org was measured on, and its typical monthly submittals + placements.

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. You inherit this board: ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters; fill rate has been ~20%. In 5–8 sentences: your first 30 days, step by step, and the number you'd promise the founder for day 90.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor (Ads & VSLs), Grow With Us
description:
We're Goldn, a fast-growing premium wellness brand, and we're scaling on paid ads and content. We're looking for ONE hungry, talented direct-response video editor to own our ad creative, someone who can edit high-converting ads, VSLs, and content that actually sells, not just pretty videos. This is a real creative role with ownership and the chance to grow into a lead content role as we scale.



Who you are:



You edit video that CONVERTS. You understand hooks, pacing, retention, and structure that sells, not just aesthetics.

You can cut all the formats: short-form ads (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), UGC ads, listicle-style video ads, long-form and short-form VSLs (video sales letters), and organic content.

You know direct-response, you get that the first 3 seconds decide everything, that pacing and pattern-interrupts keep people watching, and that the goal is the click and the sale.

You're hungry and creative. You bring hook ideas and angles, not just execution. You study what's converting and want to beat it.

You're fast and reliable, this is a volume game, we need a lot of great creative, quickly.

Fluent English (you'll follow briefs, write/place captions, and understand our brand voice and offers).



What you'll do:



Edit high-converting paid ads (short-form, UGC-style, listicle-style) for Meta and TikTok.

Edit VSLs, both longer and shorter versions, that hold attention and drive sales.

Turn raw creator footage, UGC, B-roll and scripts into scroll-stopping, converting video.

Add hooks, captions, pacing, sound design, pattern-interrupts, everything that makes DR video perform.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, angles, and formats, we want your creative brain.

Help build our whole video creative engine as we scale.



The deal (honest):



Starting pay is $4–$8/hour depending on skill. We're early-stage, so the start is modest.

BUT this is a get-in-early opportunity. As we grow (fast), there are performance bonuses, raises, and the path to a lead content role. I invest in the people who prove themselves, and I want someone who wants to build a career here long-term.



To apply (important, read carefully):



Send your portfolio / examples of ads or VSLs you've edited (links). Ideally direct-response / performance video, not just brand videos.

Tell me why you'd be great at this, in your own words.

Give me 1-2 hook ideas you'd use for a wellness/energy brand ad.



Applications without work samples won't be considered. Show me you're the one.



If this is you, apply. Let's build something big.

title: YouTube Channel Operator / Manager – Faceless Automotive Channel
description:
I am looking for a self-driven YouTube Channel Operator to take ownership of the day-to-day growth and operation of an existing faceless automotive YouTube channel.



The channel, ThrottleDust, focuses on stories about rare, forgotten and abandoned cars, barn finds and unusual automotive discoveries.



Current channel:



- 103 subscribers

- 83,000+ lifetime views

- Around 50 Shorts and 11 long-form videos

- Existing YouTube Analytics data available

- Currently not monetized

- Channel has been inactive for several months



IMPORTANT:



I am NOT looking for someone who simply edits videos or waits for me to provide topics, scripts and instructions.



I am looking for someone who can independently operate and grow the channel.



You will be responsible for:



- Researching the automotive niche and competitors

- Finding interesting video topics and opportunities

- Developing the content strategy

- Researching each story

- Creating or managing scripts

- Creating or managing video production

- Finding appropriate visuals/footage while respecting usage rights

- Voice-over production

- Thumbnails and titles

- Publishing and YouTube SEO

- Creating a Shorts strategy

- Analysing YouTube Analytics

- Improving CTR, audience retention and watch time

- Testing new ideas and formats

- Finding opportunities to grow the channel toward monetization

- Providing a short monthly report with results, costs, what was done and what you recommend doing next



You do NOT have to personally perform every production task. If you already have an efficient workflow or people you work with for editing, thumbnails, voice-over, etc., tell me about it.



My role is the owner. I will provide the budget, make major financial decisions and review performance. I do not want to manage daily content production.



We will initially start small because this is currently a small, non-monetized channel. If we find a system that works and the channel grows, I am interested in building a long-term working relationship.



TO APPLY:



Please do not send me a generic application.



Start your application with the word "THROTTLE" so I know you read the full job post.



Then answer these questions:



1. Have you previously managed or grown a YouTube channel? Please show examples and explain what YOU were responsible for.

2. Have you worked with faceless YouTube channels?

3. If you were given a dormant automotive channel with 103 subscribers and a limited budget, what would you analyse first?

4. How would you handle research, scripts, editing, thumbnails and voice-over?

5. Approximately what production costs would you expect per long-form video?

6. What would you want access to or know before creating your first 90-day plan?



Please be honest if there are parts of the process you would outsource.



I care more about someone who can think independently, analyse data and make good decisions than someone who simply follows instructions.

title: Virtual Assistant, Content + Research
description:
I’m looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant to support me with content creation, YouTube, research, and day-to-day digital tasks.



You will help edit YouTube videos, turn long-form videos into Shorts and Reels, prepare and publish YouTube Community posts, conduct research, organise and transcribe notes, proofread and edit content, and help repurpose content across platforms.



I’m looking for someone tech-savvy, organised, adaptable, detail-oriented, and able to think independently. You should be comfortable researching a topic without needing every step explained to you and confident enough to suggest ideas when you see an opportunity to improve something.



You should have experience with ClickUp, Zoom, Skool, YouTube, Opus Clip, Instagram, and Repurpose.io. Experience with video editing software is required.



You must also be comfortable tracking your time and tasks accurately in Webwork tracker with screenshots so I can clearly see what was completed and how long each task took.



This is a part-time role with the opportunity to grow as the business grows.



What I’m Looking For



I am not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.



I’m looking for someone who can look at something I have created and think, “How can I make this better?”



If you see a better way to organise something, repurpose something, research something, or improve the content, I want you to tell me.



Required Application Task



A Loom video is required. Applications without a Loom will not be considered.



I will provide you with one of my existing YouTube videos.



Please watch the video and record a 5 to 10-minute Loom explaining:



1. What you would improve about the video.



Tell me what you noticed about the editing, pacing, structure, visuals, audio, captions, hooks, retention, title, thumbnail, or anything else you believe could improve the video.



2. How you would repurpose the video.



Give me two specific Short/Reel ideas from the video. For each one, tell me the approximate timestamp you would clip, why you chose that section, and what you would use as the hook.



3. What you would do after watching the video.



I want to understand how you think. If this were your responsibility, what would you do next without me having to tell you?



4. Tell me one thing you would want to know from me before starting the role.



This helps me see whether you know how to identify missing information instead of making assumptions.



5. Tell me one idea you have for improving my content workflow.



You do not need to know anything about my business to answer this. I want to see how you think.



Hiring Process



Application → Loom test → Short interview → Paid trial task → Part-time role.



The paid trial task will involve working with a real YouTube video so I can see how you edit, repurpose content, track your work, and approach the task independently.

title: Content Creator & Storyteller – Sydney Exterior Cleaning | 20 hrs/wk, Full-Time up to US$12/hr
description:
G'day! We're Sweet Home Exterior Cleaning, a pressure cleaning and soft washing company in Sydney, Australia. We clean houses, roofs, driveways and building exteriors, and our crews film everything.



Every day our technicians shoot photos and videos on their iPhones, and everything uploads automatically to a shared iPhone library. We have HUNDREDS of unpublished clips and long raw videos, all REAL jobs with REAL people. No AI, no stock footage.



We're looking for a Content Creator & Storyteller to become the backbone of our content: someone who finds the story in the footage and posts it every day.



THE FEELING

Real, raw and human. Think "a day on the tools with mates" rather than "TV commercial". The dirt, the early starts, the tired roof that's been ignored for 20 years, the customer who can't believe it's the same house. Real and a bit rough beats polished and fake.



We do NOT want over-produced videos, fancy motion graphics or corporate-looking edits. We DO want fast cuts, strong hooks, natural captions and stories that make people feel something.



We're chasing VOLUME first, then quality. We'd rather post 5 good videos today than 1 perfect video this week.



THE TWO FORMATS WE NEED

1. Quick clips (7–20 seconds): satisfying cleans, reveals, close-ups. Several every day.

2. Story videos (60 seconds to 3+ minutes): a person, a problem, a transformation, a reaction. For example: "This house was about to be repainted for $40,000…", "Phil's first roof in the rain", "She hadn't seen her driveway this colour in 15 years."



One job should become at least 5 pieces of content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go through our shared iPhone library (new uploads every day plus a big backlog) and turn it into Reels, TikToks, Shorts and carousels

- Post daily on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube Shorts (long-form YouTube and Google Business Profile later)

- Start at 2–3 posts per half-day session and build up to around 5 per session

- Spot trends, formats and sounds on TikTok and Instagram that we can adapt

- Write hooks, captions and on-screen text that sound natural and Australian

- Make our team (Danco the founder, Paulo, Phil) and our customers the recurring characters in our stories

- Ask us for what you need (e.g. "Danco, record a 5-second hook to camera saying X")

- Keep a weekly content calendar and review the numbers with us every week. We'll decide together what to do more of.



HOW YOUR WEEK LOOKS (20 hrs)

- 4 posting sessions (about 4 hrs each): edit, create, post

- 1 strategy session (about 4 hrs): review what worked, research trends, plan next week, send shot requests to the team

- About 80% from existing footage, 20% new creative ideas



YOU MUST HAVE

- An iPhone. Our photos and videos sync through an iPhone Shared Library, so you need one to access and edit them (any computer is fine as well)

- Strong CapCut skills (Canva is a plus)

- Proof you've made content that gets views: links + screenshots of views, reach or follower growth

- Experience creating content for businesses

- Strong storytelling and good written English

- The ability to work fast and independently. You won't be told what to do every day.

- Reliable internet for uploading lots of video



BIG BONUS IF YOU

- Have worked with Australian clients or understand Aussie humour and slang

- Have created content for trades or home-service businesses (cleaning, roofing, plumbing, landscaping, real estate)

- Have grown a TikTok or Instagram account from scratch



HARD RULES

- Never post a customer's house number, street sign or number plate

- The first 2 seconds must have a hook. No slow intros, no logo intros.



PAY AND GROWTH

- Start: US$5–7/hr for 20 hrs/week, depending on proof of results

- Full-time: US$10–12/hr once you've consistently hit your posting targets and we see the numbers growing

- Long term: you lead the content side of the business as we grow



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with "SWEET HOME STORYTELLER". Applications without it won't be read. Then send:



1. A short intro and your available hours (Philippine time)

2. Links to 3–5 videos you created, with screenshots of views or results

3. Businesses or accounts you've made content for (any in Australia?)

4. STORY TEST: "A crew spends 6 hours cleaning a black, mouldy roof in Sydney. The owner is 78 and has lived there 40 years." Give us 3 hooks (the first 2 seconds) AND a 3-sentence outline of the story video you'd make.

5. GUT CHECK: "It's Friday afternoon, you've posted 2 of your 5 videos, and the new uploads are all blurry. What do you do?" (One or two sentences.)

6. Your expected hourly rate (USD)



TRIAL

Shortlisted applicants do a short trial with our real footage. If you can show proof of past results, the trial is PAID. If you're newer and can't show proof yet, you'll do a short free test (about 1 hour). We never post free test work.



We read every application personally. If you love making content that feels real and tells a story, we want to hear from you!

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote)



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



Stone Creation is a rapidly growing luxury stone fabrication and installation company based in Irvine, California. We specialize in high-end residential and commercial projects, including quartz, porcelain, natural stone, fireplaces, wall cladding, and custom architectural stonework.



We are looking for an exceptional Project Manager who will oversee projects from contract through final installation while ensuring every customer receives an outstanding experience.

This is not a position for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for a proactive, organized, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of their work, communicates exceptionally well, and enjoys solving problems before they happen.

____



About You

You are someone who:

- Takes ownership of every project.

- Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Communicates professionally and confidently with customers and team members.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment.

- Learns new software and processes quickly.

- Can prioritize multiple projects without missing deadlines.

- Thinks ahead and identifies potential issues before they become problems.

- Is resourceful, dependable, and accountable.

- Continuously looks for ways to improve systems and processes.

____



Responsibilities

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating projects from the time the contract is signed until the project is successfully completed.

Responsibilities include:

- Managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Coordinating project schedules with customers and field personnel.

- Scheduling templating, fabrication, deliveries, and installations.

- Communicating with customers throughout every stage of the project.

- Coordinating with sales, templators, fabricators, installers, and subcontractors.

- Reviewing project documentation for accuracy before production.

- Following up on customer approvals and outstanding items.

- Tracking project progress daily and ensuring deadlines are met.

- Identifying scheduling conflicts and resolving issues proactively.

- Maintaining accurate project notes and documentation.

- Ensuring all projects follow Stone Creation's internal procedures and quality standards.

- Providing exceptional customer service from start to finish.

____



Qualifications

Required

- Previous experience managing construction projects or stone fabrication/tile projects.

- Experience in the stone, tile, cabinetry, kitchen & bath, General Construction, or remodeling industry.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Outstanding organizational and time management skills.

- Strong customer service and communication skills.

- Ability to multitask and manage multiple deadlines.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

-- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Highly proficient with computers and learning new software.

____



Preferred

- Software Experience

- Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- Any construction management platform whether stone based or GC based

- Slack

- Microsoft Office

- Google Workspace

- Zoom



Don't worry if you haven't used every program—we're looking for someone who learns quickly.

____



What Success Looks Like

Our ideal Project Manager:

- Keeps projects moving without being reminded.

-Anticipates problems before they affect the customer.

-Communicates proactively with customers and the internal team.

- Maintains accurate schedules and documentation.

- Takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Helps improve our processes as the company continues to grow.

____



What We Offer

- Full-time, long-term employment.

- Opportunity for growth within a rapidly expanding company.

- Performance-based raises.

- Paid time off.

- Ongoing training and development.

A supportive team environment where your ideas and contributions matter.

We are building a team for the long term and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.

____



How to Apply

Please submit:

- Your resume.

- A short introduction about yourself.

- Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

Important: To show that you pay attention to detail, please include the words "Stone PM Ready" as the first line of your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We look forward to welcoming an exceptional Project Manager to the Stone Creation team.

title: Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer
description:
I’m looking for a video editor who can turn thoughtful talking-head footage into YouTube videos people genuinely want to finish.

My channels cover ADHD, psychology, work, and personal growth. The videos should feel clear, human, and useful. I like the polish and visual clarity of creators such as Ali Abdaal, but I want an editor who can develop the right style for my voice and audience—not copy someone else’s effects.

What you’ll do

- Shape the story: choose the strongest takes, tighten explanations, remove repetition, and make each section flow naturally into the next.

- Edit for viewer understanding and retention. Use pacing, music, captions, graphics, B-roll, and sound design when they make the idea clearer or the moment more engaging.

- Create clean, purposeful visuals that explain concepts, show examples, and give the viewer a reason to keep watching.

- Deliver polished audio, consistent colour, and a professional final export.

- Work with feedback and bring your own ideas when you spot a stronger way to tell the story.

You’d be a great fit if you:

- Have edited long-form YouTube videos and can show examples where the storytelling is strong.

- Understand hooks, curiosity, pacing, emotional beats, and payoffs—not just fast cuts.

- Know when to let a moment breathe. I’m after engaging editing, not constant zooms and stock footage.

- Can make complex ideas feel simple and visual without distorting what’s being said.

- Are organised, dependable, and comfortable collaborating through revisions.

Thumbnail design is a plus, especially if you understand how the title and thumbnail set up the promise the video needs to deliver. Please tell me whether you offer that separately.

To apply, send:

1. Two or three YouTube videos you edited, with a brief note on what you personally did.

2. One example you’re especially proud of, and why your editing choices helped the story.

3. Your editing software, typical turnaround time, availability, and rate.

4. The words “story comes first” at the start of your application so I know you read the brief.

I’ll shortlist candidates for a paid trial edit using the same footage and brief, so we can both see whether the collaboration is a good fit.

title: Client Delivery Manager — YouTube & Video Production (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
I’m George, a YouTube creator and business owner. We produce educational videos and software tutorials for brands, with a team handling scripting, editing, and design.



I’m looking for someone who can take full ownership of client delivery once I close a deal.



The goal is simple: you give me an approved script, I record the video and upload the footage, and you manage everything needed to deliver excellent work to a happy client.



You’ll be the main point of contact for clients and the person keeping our production team organized, accountable, and moving forward.



What you’ll own



Client onboarding: Collect briefs, brand assets, product access, deadlines, and everything the team needs.

Topic alignment: Coordinate ideas with the team and get client approval on topics and angles.

Scripting: Brief writers, review scripts for clarity and accuracy, manage feedback, and secure approval before recording.

Recording preparation: Give me a complete recording package, including the approved script, demo access, and any important instructions.

Production management: Coordinate writers, editors, and designers. Set realistic deadlines, follow up, and resolve blockers early.

Quality control: Review videos against the brief and approved script. Catch incorrect information, missing sections, weak edits, and wrong CTAs before the client sees them.

Client communication: Send clear updates, manage expectations, collect feedback, and keep clients informed.

Revisions: Turn feedback into clear instructions, check that changes are completed, and flag requests outside the agreed scope.

Delivery and publishing: Make sure final videos, thumbnails, descriptions, and other agreed assets are ready and delivered or published correctly.

Invoice follow-up: Track payment status, send reminders, and flag overdue payments.

Process improvement: Keep our project board accurate and improve checklists and workflows as you learn the business.



You’ll work with our existing production team. You need to be able to brief writers and editors and judge their work; personally writing and editing every video is not required.



Who we’re looking for



You have experience managing client projects at a video production company, creative agency, content business, or similar environment.



You can confidently communicate with clients in English, coordinate several projects at once, and give clear feedback to creative team members.



Most importantly, you follow through. When something is delayed, unclear, or below standard, you take action and stay with it until it is resolved.



You should be comfortable:



* Managing deadlines, dependencies, and competing priorities.

* Reviewing scripts and videos with close attention to detail.

* Having respectful but firm conversations about deadlines and quality.

* Making decisions independently within agreed boundaries.

* Bringing a proposed solution when you need help.

* Using project management tools, Google Drive, and AI tools responsibly.

* Learning software products well enough to spot mistakes in tutorials.



Experience with YouTube tutorials, software brands, and remote creative teams is a strong advantage.



What success looks like



* Scripts are approved and ready before recording.

* Every active project has a clear owner, next action, and deadline.

* Problems are raised early, with a plan to resolve them.

* Clients receive updates without having to chase us.

* Work is checked properly before it reaches the client.

* Revisions and invoice follow-ups don’t get forgotten.

* I can focus on recording while you keep delivery moving.



Working arrangement



This is a full-time role intended to become a long-term working relationship.



We need reliable availability during agreed working hours and enough capacity for this to be your primary professional commitment. Please be transparent about any other work you plan to continue.



You’ll have direct access to me, an existing production team, and clear responsibility for the delivery process. We’ll agree on your decision-making authority and when issues should be escalated.



How to apply



Please use the subject line: **Client Delivery Manager — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. A short introduction explaining why your experience fits this role.

2. An example of a video or creative project you managed. Explain what you personally owned and how many projects you handled at once.

3. A specific example of a project that went off track. What did you do, and what happened?

4. A redacted example of a project board, production brief, or client update you created. Please remove confidential information.

5. Your expected monthly salary, earliest start date, available working hours and timezone, and any ongoing work commitments.

6. Your answer to this scenario:



A video is due to the client tomorrow. The editor hasn’t delivered the draft, the client has just requested a change to the approved script, and George is unavailable for the next six hours. What would you do first, and what would you communicate to each person?**



Keep your application concise and specific. Real examples will help us understand how you work.



Our hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment based on realistic client and production situations. This takes approximately 60–75 minutes.



We’ll then have a video call to discuss your decisions. The selected finalist will complete a paid one-week trial, with the scope, schedule, and compensation agreed in advance.



We’re looking for someone who wants to take responsibility, build a strong working relationship with the team, and help us deliver work we’re proud of.
