title: Founder Led Content Video Editor
description:
Not just another "clipping" job 



If you love short form content and get frustrated seeing mass produced clips that don't understand psychology, story telling and creating emotion ... this is for you. 



We're looking for someone who loves searching through content for the part that tells a story, the hook that most people don't see and can craft a reel that makes people actually feel something. Someone who wants to create content they're actually proud of. 



A good clip is the difference between a great conversation nobody watches and content that builds someone's business, brand and community and that is what we create. 



About Project C



After landing every podcast we've ever launched on the top charts, and working with some of Australia's favourite creators, we learned exactly what separates good content from content that actually builds your business, brand and community.



We spent years searching for a studio that understood what creators need ... then we stopped searching and started building.



We wanted to build a space that inspired every person who walked in the door, that encouraged better conversation and didn't just make you sound great but make you look and feel your best as well.

The studio has Netflix Approved 4K Cameras, the Microphones the best podcasters in the world use, lighting that makes you look like you've slept 10+ hours (even when you've only slept 4) and a team that are obsessed with helping you create content you can't wait to share.



About You.



You love social media, learning the algorthims and creating content 

You edit for retention and engagement. You understand pace, tension, and why people keep watching instead of swiping.

You check your work thoroughly

You obsess over the small details. Framing, eye levels, making sure everything is optimised for the platform it is posted on and no typos

You are proactive. If you think we should change a process or there is a better way to film or feedback a host needs to hear you tell us. 

You will always met a deadline or proactively tell us if there are ever any issues 

You love creating processes and structures that make everyones lives easier

You are proactive - if you see a way for something to be done better ... you do it.

You take feedback and come back sharper. You are not precious about a cut, you are precious about the result.

You have worked with a studio or agency before on high volume work 

You want to grow with a business and have opportunities to learn and upskill

You are an excellent communicator.

BONUS - You love AI and are already building and learning to use AI tools to take your editing process to the next level 





Our Non-Negotiables



You are not an agency and you are not outsourcing the edit to someone else. You may have the opportunity to grow a team under you later, but we are hiring one editor who is excited to grow with us.

Excellent communication. If a deadline is going to be missed, you are stuck, or you need a better brief, you tell us ASAP.

You never hide problems.

You hit deadlines. 

You are proactive and make calls without being told, but you ask questions rather than guessing.



What you will own



- Cutting the podcasts filmed at our studio into finished long-form episodes that hold attention start to finish.

- Founder-led content. Taking a client's raw footage and shaping it into clips, brand pieces and story-driven edits that make them look like the authority they are.

- Short-form built for reach. Hooks, pacing, captions and clips engineered to be watched, shared and saved.

- Building your own edit templates, presets and SOPs (with AI to assist) so the work gets faster and more consistent over time.



There are opportunities for additional work in thumbnails, carousel creation, or building AI editing workflows to fill additional hours. Tell us what you love, and if it is the right fit we would love to train you and get you building other skills too.



What we offer

- Flexible working hours with a requirement to be available for some crossover in Australian business hours, 9am to 5pm AEST.

- Opportunity for growth in salary, skills and opportunity 

- Training in the AI production systems we are building. That skill will be worth more to you in three years than this job pays today.

- A long-term seat. We are not filling a gap. We are hiring the editor who shapes how Project C's content looks long term. 



Must haves



- Two or more years editing video, ideally podcast, social or branded content for a Western audience.

- A showreel or portfolio. This one is non-negotiable: we want to see both short-form clips and at least one longer, story-driven edit.

- Fluent in editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Both is a bonus. CapCut, Descript, After Effects and 
 are all a plus.

- Excellent written English.

- Reliable power, internet and a computer that can handle 4K video files, with a backup plan. You will be moving large video files, so great internet is a must.

- Full or part time, tell us what you are after.

- Extra points for colour grading, sound, motion graphics, thumbnail design, or experience editing for founder and creator brands.



How to apply



Fill out this form

title: GoHighLevel Setup and Marketing
description:
# Part-Time GoHighLevel & Digital Media Specialist

### Pasden Media



**Position:** GoHighLevel & Digital Media Specialist  

**Type:** Part-Time, Remote  

**Initial Commitment:** Approximately 10–20 hours per week, depending on workload  

**Potential:** Long-term position as Pasden Media grows



## About Pasden Media



Pasden Media is a growing independent media company producing books, videos, interviews, research-driven programming, podcasts, and digital content.



Our content covers several areas including science and unexplained phenomena, artificial intelligence and technology, health and longevity, aviation, travel, business, and smarter living.



We are building the infrastructure necessary to turn viewers and readers into a direct Pasden Media audience.



We are looking for someone who can help us build that system and then help operate it.



This is not a full-time position initially. We are looking for a capable, reliable person who can work approximately 10–20 hours per week and potentially grow with the company.



---



# THE ROLE



This position combines two primary responsibilities:



**1. GoHighLevel / Marketing Automation**



**2. Video & Digital Content Production**



You do not necessarily need to be the world's best expert in both areas, but you must be genuinely competent with GoHighLevel and capable of producing professional social-media and long-form video content.



We are looking for someone who solves problems rather than someone who needs detailed instructions for every task.



---



# RESPONSIBILITY #1

## Build and Manage Pasden Media's GoHighLevel System



The first major project will be building the Pasden Media GoHighLevel infrastructure.



This includes:



### GHL Foundation



Set up and configure our GoHighLevel account, including:



- CRM

- Contacts

- Tags

- Custom fields

- Pipelines

- Forms

-
 infrastructure

-
 authentication

- Automations

- Workflows

- Tracking

- Integrations

- User permissions

- Templates

- Testing procedures



The system should be organized using clear naming conventions so another person can understand and maintain it.



---



# LEAD CAPTURE SYSTEM



We want to build a system that converts readers and viewers into Pasden Media subscribers.



A typical funnel will look like:



**Content / Book / QR Code → Lead Capture →
 Address → Content or Bonus Material → Series Landing Page →
 Follow-Up → Ongoing Pasden Media Relationship**



The specialist will build and test this infrastructure.



---



# BOOK & SERIES LANDING PAGES



We need dedicated landing pages/content hubs for our major book properties, beginning with:



### Aliens Among Us Series



### Shadow Protocol



### The Temporal Protocol



Each series should have its own professional landing page capable of containing:



- Book information

- Images

- Videos

- Interviews

- Bonus material

- Research or supporting material

- Author commentary

- Audiobook information

- Purchase links

- Related Pasden Media content

- Future books within the series



These should be designed as expandable content hubs rather than disposable promotional pages.



---



# QR CODE SYSTEM



QR codes will be incorporated into our books, videos, printed material, and other Pasden Media content.



We want QR codes to direct users through Pasden Media-controlled URLs and lead-capture funnels.



For example:



**QR Code → Lead Capture → Subscriber Identified → Requested Content Delivered → Series Landing Page**



Different QR codes should allow us to identify the source of the subscriber, such as:



- Aliens Among Us Book 1

- Aliens Among Us Book 2

- Aliens Among Us Book 3

- Shadow Protocol

- The Temporal Protocol

- Individual videos

- Interviews

- Promotions

- Future products



The system should allow destinations and offers to change later without making QR codes already printed in books obsolete whenever practical.



---



# AUDIENCE SEGMENTATION



Subscribers should be identified according to their interests and source.



Examples include:



- Aliens Among Us

- UAP / unexplained phenomena research

- Shadow Protocol

- The Temporal Protocol

- Artificial Intelligence

- Why I AI

- Health & Vitality

- Aviation

- Beyond the Cockpit

- Travel

- Money & Smarter Living

- General Pasden Media



The objective is to communicate relevant material to subscribers rather than sending everything to everyone.



---



# AUTOMATED
 SYSTEMS



Build and maintain workflows including:



- Lead magnet delivery

- New subscriber welcome sequence

- Series-specific follow-up

- Book-reader follow-up

- Subscriber segmentation

- Re-engagement

- Customer follow-up

- Campaign tracking

- Appropriate unsubscribe/preferences management



Automations must be tested before being placed into production.



---



# REUSABLE SYSTEMS



We do not want to rebuild everything whenever Pasden Media launches another book, series, or product.



The specialist will create reusable templates for:



- Landing pages

- Lead-capture pages

- Book funnels

- Series hubs

- QR campaigns

- Lead magnets

-
 campaigns

- Welcome sequences

- Product launches

- Future Pasden Media properties



A major objective is to build a scalable system.



---



# RESPONSIBILITY #2

## Video & Digital Content Production



Pasden Media will regularly provide raw material that needs to be converted into professional finished content.



Raw material may include:



- Greg speaking directly to camera

- Interviews

- Podcast conversations

- Research discussions

- Photographs

- Book artwork

- B-roll

- Screen recordings

- Graphics

- AI-generated material

- Voice recordings

- Existing Pasden Media content



The specialist will turn this material into polished content suitable for publication.



---



# SHORT-FORM VIDEO



Create professional short-form videos for platforms such as:



- YouTube Shorts

-

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok

- X



Typical videos may range from approximately 15 seconds to several minutes depending on the subject and platform.



Responsibilities may include:



- Selecting strong portions of longer recordings

- Editing

- Pacing

- Removing unnecessary pauses

- Captions/subtitles

- B-roll

- Photographs

- Graphics

- Music where appropriate

- Sound cleanup

- Basic color correction

- Hooks

- Calls to action

- Pasden Media branding



The objective is not simply to cut a video shorter.



The objective is to create content people actually want to continue watching.



---



# LONG-FORM VIDEO



Edit longer Pasden Media programming including:



- Interviews

- Research programs

- Discussions

- Educational content

- Book-related programming

- Beyond the Cockpit

- Why I AI

- Health & Vitality

- Other Pasden Media programming



Editing may include:



- Multi-camera or interview editing

- B-roll

- Photographs

- Graphics

- Titles

- Chapter transitions

- Audio cleanup

- Music where appropriate

- Intro/outro

- Calls to action

- Removal of unnecessary pauses or repetition



Long-form videos may also become the source material for multiple short-form videos.



We want to maximize the value of every recording.



---



# CONTENT REPURPOSING



An important part of this job is recognizing that one piece of raw material can produce many pieces of content.



For example:



**One 45-minute interview**



could potentially become:



**1 long-form program**



plus



**5–15 short-form clips**



plus



**quote graphics**



plus



**social-media material**



plus



**content directing viewers toward a Pasden Media landing page or lead magnet.**



We want someone who understands this concept and actively looks for opportunities to repurpose good material.



---



# AI TOOLS



Pasden Media actively uses artificial intelligence.



You should be comfortable working with AI-assisted tools for appropriate tasks including:



- Transcription

- Captioning

- Video editing

- B-roll assistance

- Image generation

- Research organization

- Content repurposing

- Workflow automation



AI should increase productivity, not replace judgment.



We value results more than loyalty to any particular software platform.



---



# DOCUMENTATION



Anything important that you build must be documented.



Major GHL workflows should include:



- Purpose

- Trigger

- Actions

- Tags

- Conditions

- Exit conditions

- Dependencies



Short screen-recorded walkthroughs should be created for important systems when appropriate.



Pasden Media must be capable of operating the system even if the person who originally built it is unavailable.



---



# OWNERSHIP & SECURITY



All accounts, domains, phone numbers,
 systems, CRM data, creative assets, source files, automation systems, passwords, API credentials, and intellectual property remain under Pasden Media's ownership and control.



Access will be provided as necessary to perform the job.



No new paid software, subscriptions, integrations, or outside services should be added without prior approval.



---



# WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate:



- Has real GoHighLevel experience.

- Understands workflows and automation.

- Understands funnels and lead capture.

- Understands CRM organization.

- Can troubleshoot technical problems.

- Can professionally edit short-form video.

- Can edit long-form interviews/programming.

- Understands social-media formats.

- Understands audience retention and pacing.

- Is comfortable working with AI tools.

- Communicates clearly.

- Documents their work.

- Works independently.

- Meets deadlines.

- Pays attention to details.

- Can take a defined objective and figure out how to accomplish it.



We particularly value someone who says:



**“I see what you're trying to accomplish. Here's the simplest way to make it work.”**



---



# WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



We are not looking for someone who:



- Requires constant supervision.

- Claims GHL expertise but has only used basic features.

- Creates unnecessarily complicated systems.

 infrastructure configured.

title: Real Estate Video Editor - Log Grading + AI Video | $1,355-$1,500/mo | Full-Time
description:
REAL ESTATE VIDEO EDITOR | STANDARD + PREMIUM + SOCIAL + AI | FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM

$1,355 - $1,500 USD per month



Start your application with the phrase CONSISTENCY WINS. Applications without it will not be read.



READ THIS PART FIRST

We are not looking for an average editor. We are looking for someone whose work sits alongside the best real estate editors in the world, and who can then deliver that same standard on the fortieth video of the month as reliably as on the first.



We are paying accordingly. The range above is at the top of this market, and we are paying it because consistency at a high standard is the single thing our business runs on.



If you are a competent editor who wants steady work, this is not the right advert for you and we would rather not waste your time. If you are genuinely excellent, take grading seriously, are already using AI video tools properly, and want one long-term client who pays well and will not mess you around, keep reading.



ABOUT US

LuxVisuals Media produces photography, video, drone and floor plans for estate agents across London, Surrey and the surrounding areas in the UK. Our clients are established agents marketing high-value property, and they book us because our work is consistent.



See our output: 



This is a long-term, full-time position with one company, not a gig. We want to find the right person once and keep them for years.



THE ROLE

Property videos in two tiers, both to written standards we provide, plus short-form social content.



Standard: wide lens, clean simple cuts, drone included, footage corrected rather than graded, no stylised transitions or speed ramps.



Premium: wide and detail lenses, varied angles and movement, professional colour grading from log footage (never LUT-only), justified transitions, sparing speed ramps, light sound design, 3D text and motion graphics where appropriate, presenter on camera throughout.



Social clips: short vertical clips for Instagram and other social platforms, cut from our property footage and from talking-head recordings. Tight pacing, strong hooks, clean animated captions.



You must be able to do both property tiers. We are replacing a split arrangement with one editor who handles the whole range, and the Premium work is what decides who we hire.



AI VIDEO AND IMAGE TOOLS

This matters to us and it is not a nice-to-have.



We want someone already working fluently with the current generation of AI video and image tools: Higgsfield, Kling, Minimax, Seedance, Nano Banana and whatever has replaced them by the time you read this. Not someone who has watched a few tutorials. Someone who uses them in real client work, knows which tool to reach for, and can tell when an output is not good enough to ship.



Used well, these tools open up shots we cannot capture on the day. Used badly, they look cheap and they damage a listing. We need the judgement as much as the skill.



If you are strong on grading but have not touched AI tools, still apply and say so; but the people who have both will go to the top of the pile.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit Standard and Premium property videos to our written standards

- Colour grade from log footage properly, not applying a LUT and moving on

- Cut short vertical social clips from property footage and talking-head recordings, with hooks and animated captions

- Produce AI-assisted shots and elements where they genuinely improve the piece

- Cut landscape and portrait as separate purpose-built edits, never crops

- Include every filmed room and never misrepresent a property's layout

- Captions, text and branding to our specification

- Sound design and licensed music on Premium edits

- Export to spec: 4K UHD, 25fps, H.264 MP4, Rec.709, correct bitrates

- Follow our file naming convention exactly, every time

- Deliver to the folder named in the job notes

- Turn revisions around fast when QC flags something



SOFTWARE

DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro only. These are the two tools our workflow and our training material are built around. If you work primarily in Premiere Pro, this role is not a fit. You need to be genuinely strong in at least one, particularly on grading.



Plus fluency in current AI video and image tools, as above.



TRAINING WE PROVIDE

This is not a role where you are handed a brief and left alone.



We have licensed a professional video editing course produced by one of the best media companies in the world, covering both DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro. Every editor we hire gets access as part of the role. It is there to sharpen skills you already have (we are not training beginners), but it means the standard we ask for is one we actively help you reach and hold.



You also get our written Standard and Premium specifications, worked examples, and direct feedback on your output.



VOLUME AND TURNAROUND

A typical day is 2-3 property videos, and quieter periods are lighter. Volume moves with the property market. On a busy day it can reach 2-3 Standard plus 1-2 Premium. Those days are the exception, but they happen. Social clips fit around the property work.



- Standard: 24 hours from receiving footage

- Premium: 48 hours from receiving footage

- Revisions: same day when QC flags them



Landscape and portrait are separate purpose-built edits rather than crops, so each video means two finished cuts.



These deadlines are firm. Our clients have listings going live and we do not get to be late.



SCHEDULE

- Monday to Friday: full editing days

- Saturday: a full working day, editing Friday's shoots

- Sunday: revisions only, a short window to clear anything QC has flagged. Not a full day



You must be genuinely available on Saturdays. Friday is one of our busiest shoot days and that work cannot sit until Monday. If Saturdays do not work for you, please do not apply.



Some overlap with UK working hours is required.



PAY

$1,355 - $1,500 USD per month, depending on demonstrated ability across both tiers, social clips and AI tools. Paid on time, every time, without being chased. Rate reviews as your speed and quality grow.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU ARE

- Obsessive about consistency; the tenth video looks like the first

- A real colourist, not a preset user

- Already deep in AI video tools and following where they go next

- Able to make a short clip stop the scroll in the first two seconds

- Deadline-driven and honest when something is at risk

- Able to follow written SOPs and examples precisely

- Comfortable at volume without the quality sliding

- Responsive to feedback and quick to apply it permanently, not just once

- Meticulous with file naming, organisation and delivery

- Communicative; you tell us before a deadline slips, not after

- Still trying to get better. The course we provide is wasted on someone who thinks they are finished learning



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong real estate video portfolio

- Demonstrable log grading work you graded yourself

- Short-form social clip examples (Reels, TikTok or Shorts)

- Hands-on experience with AI video and image tools in real client work

- Reliable high-speed internet capable of moving 4K files daily

- A computer that handles 4K editing comfortably

- Licensed access to DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro

- Availability across the schedule above, Saturdays included

- Real estate video editing experience: required



HOW TO APPLY

Start with CONSISTENCY WINS, then send:

1. A short introduction: who you are and why this role

2. Your real estate video editing experience

3. Links to your three best property videos. At least one must be a premium-standard graded piece

4. For one of those: confirm you graded it yourself, and name the source footage (log profile, camera)

5. Links to two short-form social clips you edited

6. Which AI video or image tools you use, and a link to something you made with them. Tell us which tool did what

7. Which editing software you use: DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro

8. Your typical turnaround per video

9. Your exact availability, including Saturdays, in your local time and UK time

10. Your expected monthly rate in USD

11. A screenshot of your internet speed test

12. Your CV



Applications that skip items or send generic showreels with no property work will not be shortlisted.



THE TEST EDIT

This is how we decide, so read it properly.



Shortlisted applicants get raw files from recent LuxVisuals shoots, along with our written editing standards.



One property is set and everybody edits it, to Premium standard. That is the piece we compare like for like, and it decides most of this.



From that same set property, you also cut one short vertical social clip (15-30 seconds) with a hook and captions.



A second property is optional and yours to choose from the files we send, also to Premium. Take it only if you can do it without the first one suffering. Two Premium edits inside the window is what one of our busy days actually looks like. One outstanding edit beats two rushed ones, every time.



You have 48 hours from the moment you receive the files, whether you attempt one property or two. That is not arbitrary: it is the deadline a Premium edit carries in this job. We know you are fitting this around existing work. So is everyone else.



You are judged on the quality of the edit and on when it lands. Quality decides it. Delivery time is recorded and separates close calls.



The top 20% of test edits go through to interview. From there we choose one person.



The test is unpaid, and we are upfront about why. At this level of pay we are not asking you to take our word for the standard, and we are not taking yours either. It is the same opportunity for everyone and your work decides it. If that is not a trade you want to make, we understand, and there are no hard feelings.



Everyone who submits a test gets a reply from us either way.

title: Part-Time Marketing Coordinator – Inbound Marketing & AI
description:
About us



We are Datamills UK Ltd, an established UK IT services company working primarily with small and medium-sized businesses.



We are looking for a part-time Marketing Coordinator who can help us turn marketing ideas into practical, joined-up marketing activity.



What we are trying to achieve



We already have lots of ideas and increasingly use ChatGPT and other AI tools to help develop concepts, propositions, wording and initial creative ideas.



What we need is someone who can help take those ideas and move them forward — turning an idea into a practical inbound marketing campaign and coordinating the different pieces required to deliver it.



We are not looking simply for someone to create lots of social media posts or general marketing noise. We want to develop useful marketing assets that attract potential customers, educate them and give them a reason to engage with us.



For example, we might start with an idea for promoting one of our IT services. Together with AI, we may develop the initial proposition, messaging and creative concept.



We would then like our Marketing Coordinator to help determine:



• Who are we trying to reach?

• What problem are we helping them solve?

• What is the key message?

• What marketing assets should we create?

• Do we need a flyer, guide, checklist, banner, landing page or website content?

• How should those assets work together?

• What do we want the potential customer to do next?

• How do we turn initial interest into an enquiry?



The role



Initially, the role will involve helping us:



• Develop ideas into simple inbound marketing campaigns

• Create and maintain a basic marketing plan

• Turn AI-generated concepts and content into clear briefs

• Identify the marketing assets required for each campaign

• Coordinate specialist freelancers such as graphic designers, copywriters and web designers when required

• Review completed work and make sure it remains consistent with the original objective and our brand

• Help keep marketing projects organised and moving through to completion

• Gradually develop a more consistent inbound marketing approach for the business



You do not need to personally be an expert graphic designer, copywriter or website developer. We are happy to use specialist freelancers for those areas.



However, you should understand how these different disciplines fit together and be capable of coordinating them.



Who we are looking for



We are looking for someone who:



• Understands digital and inbound marketing

• Can think about the customer journey rather than just individual marketing tasks

• Is organised and good at coordinating work

• Has excellent written English

• Is comfortable working with ChatGPT and AI-generated content

• Can take a rough idea and help turn it into a practical plan

• Is comfortable challenging or improving an idea rather than simply following instructions

• Can work independently and keep projects moving



Experience with a UK, B2B, technology or IT services business would be useful, but is not essential.



Hours and longer-term opportunity



We want to start small, initially around 2 hours per week.



Our priority is finding the right person and building a long-term working relationship. If it works well, there is potential for the hours and responsibilities to increase.



When applying



Please tell us:



A little about yourself and your marketing experience.

Your experience with inbound marketing and lead generation.

An example where you took an initial idea and helped turn it into a campaign or collection of marketing assets.

Your experience coordinating designers, web developers, copywriters or other freelancers.

How you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your marketing work.

Your hourly rate and availability.



Please start your application with the words “Marketing Mouse” so we know you have read the complete job description.

title: E-Commerce Operations & Growth Manager – Full Ownership
description:
ABOUT COZAD COMMERCE



Cozad Commerce LLC is a U.S.-based e-commerce company building a multi-store, multi-channel e-commerce portfolio.



We are developing a general online store alongside multiple specialized/niche stores, with sales channels including Shopify, eBay, TikTok Shop, and additional marketplaces as the business grows.



Our Shopify, AutoDS, CJ Dropshipping, eBay, TikTok Shop, and related infrastructure are currently in various stages of setup.



You will be our first E-Commerce Operations & Growth Manager and will build this department from the ground up.





ROLE MISSION



This is a FULL-OWNERSHIP role.



You are not being hired simply to assist the owner with e-commerce. You are being hired to BUILD the operation, LAUNCH it, GENERATE REVENUE, SCALE it, BUILD YOUR TEAM, MANAGE YOUR TEAM, and ultimately RUN the day-to-day e-commerce department.



Your first responsibility will be to evaluate what has already been completed, finish the connections, build what is missing, test the complete workflow, launch the stores and sales channels, and create an operation capable of scaling quickly and responsibly.



Our goal is to get Cozad Commerce fully operational, generating meaningful revenue, and growing as efficiently as possible.



This is NOT an entry-level VA position. Previous hands-on e-commerce experience is required.





WHAT YOU WILL BUILD & OWN



• Build, configure, connect, and launch Shopify stores from the ground up

• Establish and operate our general store and multiple specialized/niche stores

• Structure and manage multiple Shopify stores efficiently

• Configure and optimize AutoDS, CJ Dropshipping, supplier connections, inventory, and order workflows

• Connect and manage Shopify, eBay, TikTok Shop, and additional approved sales channels

• Build scalable product, inventory, order, and fulfillment systems

• Troubleshoot synchronization, supplier, inventory, fulfillment, and marketplace issues

• Understand marketplace policies, seller performance, account health, and selling limits

• Responsibly grow new marketplace accounts such as eBay from initial selling limits into larger operations while remaining compliant with platform rules

• Build SOPs, QA processes, dashboards, reporting, and accountability systems

• Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve how the department operates

• Take increasing ownership of daily e-commerce decisions without requiring constant owner direction





PRODUCT RESEARCH → LISTING → ANALYZE → SCALE



You should understand the complete e-commerce product lifecycle:



Research → Validate → Source → Price → List → Launch → Analyze → Identify Winners → Scale



You will conduct and oversee:



• Product research and opportunity identification

• Supplier research and evaluation

• Margin and pricing analysis

• Product validation

• Listing creation and optimization

• Product testing

• Performance analysis

• Identifying winning products and categories

• Scaling successful opportunities

• Improving or discontinuing products that do not perform



As the department grows, these functions should become repeatable systems that can be delegated to specialists while you maintain oversight and quality control.





AI & AUTOMATION



AI proficiency is important to this role.



You should be comfortable using modern AI tools to improve product research, listing development, analysis, documentation, SOP creation, reporting, and operational efficiency.



We want someone who naturally asks:



“Can this be automated, systemized, delegated, or made more efficient?”



You should be capable of turning repetitive manual work into repeatable systems, AI-assisted workflows, automation, and delegated processes while maintaining appropriate human QA.



Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar AI/automation tools is a strong plus.





BUILD & MANAGE YOUR OWN TEAM



You will begin hands-on because this department is being built from the ground up.



As the operation grows, you will be expected to:



• Determine which additional e-commerce positions are needed

• Help create those roles

• Recruit and interview Philippines-based candidates

• Participate directly in hiring decisions

• Onboard and train your team

• Assign responsibilities and delegate work

• Establish KPIs and productivity expectations

• Monitor quality and performance

• Coach team members and solve operational problems

• Build a reliable team capable of operating independently



You should be comfortable becoming the primary manager for the e-commerce employees working underneath you.



The progression of this role is:



Build the operation → Scale the operation → Build your team → Manage the department.





WORK CLOSELY WITH MARKETING



You will work closely with a separate E-Commerce Growth & Marketing Manager/Specialist responsible for social media, paid advertising, customer acquisition, creative strategy, and marketing analytics.



Commerce and Marketing will work together to:



• Coordinate product and store launches

• Identify products gaining traction

• Analyze customer and sales data

• Improve conversion

• Determine where resources should be allocated

• Scale winning products and categories

• Build sustainable revenue and profitability



You should understand revenue, margins, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, and ROAS well enough to collaborate effectively with Marketing, although paid advertising will not be your primary responsibility.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this position means:



• Stores and sales channels are properly built, connected, tested, and operating

• Products are consistently researched, validated, listed, tested, and scaled

• Revenue is being generated and growing sustainably

• Margins and profitability remain healthy

• Marketplace accounts remain compliant and healthy

• Orders and fulfillment operate reliably

• AI and automation reduce unnecessary manual work

• SOPs and systems allow work to be delegated consistently

• A capable e-commerce team is recruited, trained, and managed successfully

• Problems are solved without unnecessary escalation

• The department continuously identifies and implements opportunities for growth

• Routine owner involvement in day-to-day e-commerce operations is reduced as close to zero as practical



The owner should primarily be involved when strategic direction, significant approvals, budget decisions, or genuine escalations are required.



Speed matters.



We want this operation launched, producing revenue, and scaling as efficiently as possible. We are looking for someone who can move quickly, test intelligently, identify what works, and turn early traction into sustainable revenue and profitable growth without sacrificing marketplace compliance, customer experience, listing quality, or operational accuracy.





COMPENSATION & FAST-TRACK GROWTH



Starting Pay: $9 USD/hour

Hours: Approximately 30–35 hours/week

Pay Schedule: Weekly

Position: Long-term



Fast-track opportunity to $10/hour based on demonstrated performance, meaningful revenue generation, sustainable business growth, and successful operational execution.



Additional opportunities include:



• Performance-based bonuses for exceptional measurable results

• Additional compensation increases as revenue, profitability, team responsibility, and business performance grow

• Increased leadership responsibility

• Advancement into Senior E-Commerce Operations Manager / Head of E-Commerce



Compensation growth is results-driven — not based solely on time in the position.



Someone who comes in, successfully builds the operation, helps generate meaningful revenue, demonstrates strong leadership, and produces measurable results will not need to wait for an arbitrary annual review to have their compensation reconsidered.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



We are looking for substantial hands-on e-commerce experience, preferably including several of the following:



• Shopify store building and management

• Multi-store e-commerce operations

• AutoDS

• CJ Dropshipping or similar supplier platforms

• eBay Seller operations

• TikTok Shop

• Dropshipping

• Product research and validation

• Supplier sourcing and evaluation

• Product listing and optimization

• Inventory, order, and fulfillment workflows

• Marketplace account health and policies

• AI-assisted e-commerce workflows

• Automation and integrations

• SOP and process development

• Hiring, interviewing, training, or managing remote e-commerce workers



You do NOT need to have used every platform listed above.



However, you MUST have real hands-on experience building and operating e-commerce systems and be capable of taking ownership rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



Management experience is strongly preferred.



Experience managing Philippines-based remote workers is a major plus.





IMMEDIATE HIRE



We are actively reviewing candidates and intend to fill this position quickly.



We are looking for someone who can begin taking ownership immediately and is genuinely excited about building an e-commerce department from the ground up and eventually leading the team they helped create.





HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with:



COZAD COMMERCE



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be considered.



Please answer:



1. How many years of hands-on e-commerce experience do you have?



2. Which of these platforms have you personally used professionally: Shopify, AutoDS, CJ Dropshipping, eBay, and TikTok Shop?



3. Describe an e-commerce store or business you personally helped build or scale. What exactly were you responsible for?



4. Have you built a Shopify store or e-commerce operation from the ground up? Explain what you personally handled.



5. Describe your experience with product research, product validation, supplier evaluation, and listing optimization.



6. Describe a difficult e-commerce, integration, fulfillment, or marketplace problem you personally solved.



7. What experience do you have hiring, interviewing, training, or managing remote workers?



8. If you were given a budget to hire two e-commerce specialists underneath you, which two roles would you hire first, what would each person own, and how would you measure their performance?



9. Imagine you inherit partially completed Shopify + AutoDS + CJ Dropshipping + eBay + TikTok Shop infrastructure and are responsible for building the department from the ground up. What would your first 30 days look like?



10. What is your current availability and earliest possible start date?



Please include examples, links, screenshots, portfolio materials, or other evidence of stores or e-commerce operations you have worked on where available.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a brief video introduction and/or practical assessment before final selection.
